03004000.en: Z axis homing failed; the task has been stopped.
03004000.zh: Z轴回零失败，任务已停止。

03004001.en: The printer timed out waiting for the nozzle to cool down before homing.

03004002.en: Auto Bed Leveling failed; the task has been stopped.
03004002.zh: 热床调平失败，任务已停止。

03004005.en: The hotend cooling fan speed is abnormal.
03004005.zh: 热端散热风扇转速异常。

03004008.en: The AMS failed to change filament.

0300400F.en: The power supply voltage does not match the printer.
0300400F.zh: 电源电压与打印机不匹配。

03004011.en: Flow Dynamics Calibration failed; please reinitiate printing or calibration.
03004011.zh: 动态流量校准失败。请重新发起打印或校准。

03004013.en: Printing cannot be initiated while AMS is drying.

03004014.en: Homing Z axis failed: temperature control abnormality.

03004015.en: Nozzle clumping detection calibration failed. Please go to 'Assistant' for troubleshooting.
03004015.zh: 喷嘴裹头位置检测失败，请前往“助手”排查问题。

03004016.en: Nozzle cleaning failed. Please click the Assistant for troubleshooting.
03004016.zh: 喷嘴清理失败，请查看助手排除故障。

0300401F.en: The hotend is not installed, and the toolhead cannot perform homing. Please install the hotend and then continue. / The right hotend is not installed, and the toolhead cannot perform homing. Please install the hotend and then continue.
0300401F.zh: 右侧热端未安装，无法进行回中。请安装热端后再继续操作。 / 热端未安装，无法进行回中。请安装热端后再继续操作。

03004020.en: The nozzle presence detection failed. Please check the Assistant for details.
03004020.zh: 喷嘴在位检测失败。请前往助手查看详情。

03004021.en: Nozzle offset calibration sensor signal abnormality detected. Please check the sensor and retry.
03004021.zh: 检测到喷嘴偏移校准传感器信号异常。建议排查传感器故障后重试。

03004030.en: Z-axis homing failed. Remove the heated bed slider fixing screws and ensure no obstructions are blocking the heated bed's vertical movement. After resolving the issue, recalibrate on the device.
03004030.zh: Z轴回零失败，请取出热床滑块固定螺丝并确认热床升降无异物阻挡，解决问题后在设备上重新校准。

03004031.en: The nozzle has not been installed. Please install the nozzle and recalibrate.
03004031.zh: 检测到喷嘴未安装。请安装喷嘴后重新校准。

03004032.en: XY homing failed. Please remove any foreign objects obstructing the toolhead movement and recalibrate.
03004032.zh: XY回零失败，请移除阻挡工具头移动的异物后再重新校准。

03004033.en: Z-axis homing failed due to a temperature control abnormality. Please refer to the help instructions to resolve the issue, then recalibrate on the device.
03004033.zh: Z轴回零失败：温控异常。请查看帮助解决问题后，在设备上重新校准。

03004035.en: Nozzle cleaning failed. Please refer to the help instructions to resolve the issue, then recalibrate on the device.
03004035.zh: 喷嘴清理失败。请查看帮助解决问题后，在设备上重新校准。

03004036.en: Nozzle offset calibration failed. Please refer to the help instructions to resolve the issue, then recalibrate on the device.
03004036.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准失败。请查看帮助解决问题后，在设备上重新校准。

03004037.en: Nozzle clumping detection calibration failed. Please refer to the help instructions to resolve the issue, then recalibrate on the device.
03004037.zh: 喷嘴裹头位置检测失败。请查看帮助解决问题后，在设备上重新校准。

03004038.en: Heatbed leveling failed. Please refer to the help instructions to resolve the issue, then recalibrate on the device.
03004038.zh: 热床调平失败。请查看帮助解决问题后，在设备上重新校准。

03004039.en: The nozzle presence detection failed. Please refer to the help instructions to resolve the issue, then recalibrate on the device.
03004039.zh: 喷嘴在位检测失败。请查看帮助解决问题后，在设备上重新校准。

03004042.en: The Laser Safety Window is not properly installed. The task has been stopped.
03004042.zh: 未正确安装激光防护视窗，任务已停止。

03004044.en: The Flame Sensor is abnormal. The sensor may be short-circuited. Please troubleshoot the issue before starting a print job.
03004044.zh: 火焰传感器异常，传感器可能短路，请排查故障后再发起任务。

0300404B.en: Task aborted because the front door or top cover is open.
0300404B.zh: 任务终止，检测到机箱前门或上盖打开。

0300404D.en: The current temperature of the hotend, heatbed, or chamber is too high. Please wait for it to cool down to room temperature before restarting the task.
0300404D.zh: 当前热端、热床或腔体温度过高，请等待温度降至室温后重新发起任务。

03004050.en: Liveview Camera calibration timeout; please restart the printer.
03004050.zh: 实况相机校准响应超时，请重启打印机。

03004057.en: Z-axis step loss detected. The task has stopped. Please check if there are any obstructions beneath the heatbed.
03004057.zh: 检测到Z轴丢步，任务已停止，请检查热床下方是否有异物。

03004059.en: The workpiece on the rotary attachment collided with the toolhead. The task has been stopped.
03004059.zh: 检测到激光旋转轴上的加工物体与工具头碰撞，任务已停止。

03004066.zh: 运动精度增强发生异常，请查看助手。

03004067.en: Calibration result is over the threshold.
03004067.zh: 校准完成，运动精度有提升。由于机器结构的老化等原因，可能不是最佳效果。

03004068.en: Step loss occurred during the motion accuracy enhancement process. Please try again.
03004068.zh: 运动精度增强过程发生丢步，请重试。

03008000.en: Printing was paused for unknown reason. You can select 'Resume' to resume the print job.
03008000.zh: 未知原因暂停。你可以点击“继续打印”来恢复打印任务。

03008001.en: Printing was paused by the user. You can select 'Resume' to continue printing.
03008001.zh: 用户暂停。你可以点击“继续打印”来恢复打印任务。

03008002.en: First layer defects were detected by the Micro Lidar. Please check the quality of the printed model before continuing your print.
03008002.zh: 激光雷达检测到首层缺陷,请检查打印件状况后决定是否继续。

03008003.en: Spaghetti defects were detected by the AI Print Monitoring. Please check the quality of the printed model before continuing your print. Cleaning the build plate or drying the filament can effectively reduce the risk of spaghetti failure.
03008003.zh: AI检测到炒面缺陷。请检查打印件状况后做相应处理。清洗打印板、烘干耗材，可以有效降低炒面风险。

03008004.en: Filament ran out. Please load new filament.
03008004.zh: 打印耗材用尽，请加载新料。

03008005.en: Toolhead front cover fell off. Please remount the front cover and check to make sure your print is going okay.
03008005.zh: 工具头前盖掉落。请把前盖重新装上，并检查打印件是否完好。

03008006.en: The build plate marker was not detected. Please confirm the build plate is correctly positioned on the heatbed with all four corners aligned, and the marker is visible.
03008006.zh: 未检测到打印板定位标识。请检查打印板是否放置且四角对齐，并保证定位标识清晰无磨损。

03008007.en: There was an unfinished print job when the printer lost power. If the model is still adhered to the build plate, you can try resuming the print job.
03008007.zh: 检测到断电时有未完成的打印任务。如果模型仍然粘接在底板上，可尝试继续打印。

03008008.en: Nozzle temperature malfunction. Check the Assistant page and resolve the issue before retrying heating.
03008008.zh: 喷嘴温控故障：请前往助手页面查看详情，排除异常后再重新加热。

0300800A.en: A Filament pile-up was detected by AI Print Monitoring. Please clean filament from the waste chute.
0300800A.zh: AI打印监控检测到垃圾桶处废料堆积，请及时清理。

0300800B.en: The cutter is stuck. Please make sure the cutter handle is out and check the filament sensor cable connection.
0300800B.zh: 切刀已卡住，请确保切刀刀柄弹回及耗材霍尔开关接线正常。

0300800C.en: Multiple motion steps lost detected. Please check if the toolhead is blocked by obstructions or making abnormal noise. You may continue printing to observe. If the print shows layer shifting, refer to the Wiki for maintenance.
0300800C.zh: 检测到多次运动丢步，请先检查工具头是否有异物阻挡或异响。可继续打印观察打印件，如出现明显错层请参考 Wiki 维护。

0300800D.en: Detected that the extruder is not extruding normally. If the defects are acceptable, select 'Resume' to resume the print job.
0300800D.zh: 检测到没有正常挤出。如果缺陷可接受，可点击'继续打印'按钮来恢复打印任务。

0300800E.en: The print file is not available. Please check to see if the storage media has been removed.
0300800E.zh: 检测到打印文件不可用。请确认存储介质是否被移除。

0300800F.en: The door seems to be open, so printing was paused.
0300800F.zh: 检测到门已打开，暂停打印。

03008010.en: The hotend cooling fan speed is abnormal.
03008010.zh: 热端散热风扇转速异常。

03008011.en: Detected build plate is not the same as the Gcode file. Please adjust slicer settings or use the correct plate.
03008011.zh: 检测到的打印板类型与切片G代码中不一致。请修改切片参数或者使用匹配的打印板。

03008013.en: Printing paused due to the pause command added to the printing file.
03008013.zh: 打印暂停，因为打印文件中添加了暂停命令。

03008014.en: The nozzle is covered with filament, or the build plate is installed incorrectly. Please cancel this print and clean the nozzle or adjust the build plate according to the actual status. You can also select 'Resume' to resume the print job.
03008014.zh: 检测到喷嘴裹料或打印板放歪，请根据实际状态，取消本次打印并清理喷嘴或调整热床，或点击“继续”按钮恢复打印任务。

03008015.en: The filament on external spool has run out; please load new filament. If the filament is loaded, please select 'Resume'.
03008015.zh: 外挂料盘上的耗材用尽，请进料新的耗材。如果已经执行进料流程，请点击'继续'。

03008016.en: The nozzle is clogged with filament. Please cancel this print and clean the nozzle or select 'Resume' to resume the print job.
03008016.zh: 检测到挤出机无法挤出料。请根据实际状态，取消本次打印并清理挤出机，或点击“继续打印”按钮恢复打印任务。

03008017.en: Foreign objects detected on heatbed. Please check and clean the heatbed. Then, select 'Resume' to resume the print job.
03008017.zh: 检测到热床上有异物，请检查并清理后，再点击“继续打印”按钮继续打印。

03008019.en: Build plate not detected. Please ensure there are no bulges or debris on the plate and that the nozzle is clean.
03008019.zh: 未检测到打印板。请检查打印板表面是否存在鼓包或异物，并确保喷嘴已清理干净。

0300801A.en: Filament extrusion error; please check the assistant for troubleshooting. After resolving the issue, decide whether to cancel or resume the print job based on the actual print status.
0300801A.zh: 耗材挤出异常，请查看助手。排除故障后，根据实际打印件状态，选择取消或者继续打印。

0300801B.en: Nozzle temperature problem detected. Refer to Assistant to re-connect the hotend connector. POWER OFF the printer before this operation to avoid short circuits.
0300801B.zh: 喷嘴温控故障，请查看助手重新插接喷嘴接线。全过程请断电操作，否则可能有短路风险。

0300801C.en: The extrusion resistance is abnormal. The extruder may be clogged; please refer to the assistant. After trouble shooting, you can select 'Resume' to resume the print job.
0300801C.zh: 检测到挤出机挤出阻力异常，可能堵头。请查看助手，排除异常后，点击'继续打印'恢复打印任务。

0300801D.en: The extruder servo motor position sensor is malfunctioning. Please power off the printer first and check if the connection cable is loose.
0300801D.zh: 挤出电机位置传感器异常，请先切断电源，检查连接线是否松动。

0300801E.en: The extrusion motor is overloaded, please check the Assistant for details.
0300801E.zh: 挤出电机过载，请前往助手查看详情。

03008021.en: The nozzle may not be installed or not properly installed. Please ensure the nozzle is correctly installed before proceeding.
03008021.zh: 喷嘴可能未安装或安装未到位，请正确安装后继续。

03008022.en: During subsequent printing, the heatbed may encounter resistance while lowering. Please clear any foreign objects from beneath the heatbed and observe whether its movement is obstructed.
03008022.zh: 在后续打印过程中，热床下降可能受阻，请清理热床底部异物，并观察热床移动是否卡顿。

03008028.en: Nozzle offset calibration sensor error. If using a single hotend or the calibration function is disabled, you may ignore this and continue printing; otherwise, it is recommended to check the sensor before proceeding.
03008028.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准传感器异常，若使用单热端打印或已关闭校准功能，可忽略继续打印；否则建议先排查故障。

03008041.en: Platform detection timeout: please restart the printer.
03008041.zh: 垫板检测超时，请重启打印机。

03008042.en: Task paused because the door is open. / Task paused because the door or top cover is open.
03008042.zh: 任务暂停，检测到机箱前门或上盖打开。 / 任务暂停，检测到机箱前门打开。

03008045.en: Material detection timeout: please restart the printer.
03008045.zh: 制作材料检测超时，请重启打印机。

03008046.en: Foreign object detect timeout: please restart the printer.
03008046.zh: 异物检测超时，请重启打印机。

03008047.en: Quick-release lever detection time out: please restart the printer.
03008047.zh: 快拆锁扣检测超时，请重启打印机。

03008048.en: Laser Module unlock has timed out, and the task cannot proceed. Please restart the printer and try again.
03008048.zh: 激光模组解锁超时，任务无法继续，请重启机器后重试。

0300804A.en: Emergency stop button improperly installed. Please reinstall according to the Wiki before proceeding.
0300804A.zh: 急停按钮安装状态异常，请按照Wiki正确安装后继续任务。

0300804B.en: Task paused. The Laser Safety Window is open.
0300804B.zh: 任务暂停，检测到激光防护视窗打开。

0300804E.en: This is a printing task. Please detach the Laser/Cutting Module from the Toolhead.
0300804E.zh: 打印任务进行中，请将激光/刀切模组从工具头取下。

0300804F.en: The loading/unloading process is currently ongoing. Please stop the process or remove the laser/cutting module.
0300804F.zh: 设备正在进退料。请停止当前流程，或取下激光/刀切模组。

03008050.en: This device does not support the 40W Laser Module. Please remove it or replace it with a 10W Laser Module.
03008050.zh: 该设备不支持40W激光模组，请移除或更换10W激光模组。

03008051.en: The cutting module has dropped or the cutting module cable is disconnected; please check the module.
03008051.zh: 刀切模组掉落或者连接线脱落，请检查。

03008053.en: Laser module detected. Please install the right nozzle correctly to ensure proper Laser Module Mounting Calibration.
03008053.zh: 已检测到激光模组，请正确安装右喷嘴，以确保后续激光模组挂载校准正常。

03008054.en: Please place the paper required for Print Then Cut.
03008054.zh: 请放置打印后刀切工序所需的纸张

03008055.en: The module mounted on the toolhead does not match the task. Please install the correct module.
03008055.zh: 当前工具头挂载的模组与任务不匹配，请安装正确的模组。

03008057.en: The rotary attachment is disconnected. Please ensure it is properly installed and the cable is securely plugged in.
03008057.zh: 检测到旋转轴附件未连接，请确认附件已正确安装并插好连接线。

03008058.en: The rotary attachment is detected. Please remove it before continuing.
03008058.zh: 检测到已安装旋转轴附件，请将其取下后继续操作。

03008059.en: Motor step loss detected. Please check the processing quality. If the quality is acceptable, continue; otherwise, stop the task.
03008059.zh: 检测到电机丢步，请检查加工质量。若质量可接受，可继续执行；若不可接受，请停止任务。

03008061.en: The mode of Airflow System failed to activate; check the air door condition.
03008061.zh: 风道系统切换或维持失败，请检查风门状态。

03008062.en: The chamber temperature is too high. It may be due to high environmental temperature.
03008062.zh: 腔温过高，可能因为环境温度过高。

03008063.en: The chamber temperature is too high. Please open the top cover and front door to cool down.
03008063.zh: 腔温过高，请打开上盖和前门降温。

03008064.en: The chamber temperature is too high. Please open the top cover and front door to cool down. (Open door detection for this print job will be set to 'Notification' level)
03008064.zh: 腔温过高，请打开上盖和前门降温。（打开上盖或前门后，本次打印的开门检测功能将设置为“通知”级别）

03008065.en: The temperature of the MC module is too high. Please check the Wiki for possible explanations.
03008065.zh: MC模块温度过高，请前往Wiki排查具体原因。

0300806E.en: Abnormal nozzle temperature control detected; the heating module may be damaged. Please disconnect the power immediately and stop using the device.
0300806E.zh: 喷嘴温控异常，可能为加热模块损坏。请立即断开设备电源。

0300806F.en: Abnormal temperature rise detected on the heatbed. The heating module may be damaged. Please power off the device immediately and stop using it.
0300806F.zh: 热床异常升温，可能为加热模块损坏，请立即断开设备电源并停止使用。

03008070.en: The chamber heater temperature is rising abnormally and the heating module may be damaged. Please power off the device immediately and stop using the device.
03008070.zh: 检测到腔温加热器异常升温，可能为加热模块损坏。请立即断开设备电源并停止使用。

03008071.en: The Toolhead Enhanced Cooling Fan module is malfunctioning.
03008071.zh: 工具头散热增强风扇模组异常。

0300807D.en: Fire Extinguisher not detected, the automatic extinguishing function will be unavailable.
0300807D.zh: 灭火器未连接，自动灭火功能将无法使用。

0300807E.en: Fire Extinguisher not detected, the automatic extinguishing function will be unavailable.
0300807E.zh: 灭火器未连接，自动灭火功能将无法使用。

03008081.en: Fire extinguisher cylinder not installed. Please confirm on the extinguisher page.
03008081.zh: 灭火器气瓶未安装，请前往灭火器页面确认。

03008082.en: The Fire Extinguisher Gas Cylinder is empty.

0300C012.en: Please heat the nozzle to above 170°C.

0300C056.en: A minor fire was detected inside the chamber, and the Auto Fire Extinguishing process has been aborted.
0300C056.zh: 机箱内火势较小，已智能取消自动灭火。

0300C070.en: The fire extinguisher has been detected and is ready for use after the laser module is connected.
0300C070.zh: 检测到灭火器接入，待激光组件接入后即可使用。

05004001.en: Failed to connect to Bambu Cloud. Please check your network connection.
05004001.zh: 无法连接服务器，请检查网络连接。

05004002.en: Unsupported print file path or name. Please resend the print job.
05004002.zh: 不支持的打印文件路径或者名称，请重新发起打印。

05004003.en: Printing stopped because the printer was unable to parse the file. Please resend your print job.
05004003.zh: 解析3mf文件遇到问题，打印已停止。请重新发送打印。

05004004.en: Device is busy and cannot start new task. Please wait for current task to complete before sending new task.
05004004.zh: 设备正忙，无法启动新的任务，请在当前任务结束后再发送新任务。

05004005.en: Print jobs are not allowed to be sent while updating firmware.
05004005.zh: 不允许在固件更新过程中发送打印任务。

05004006.en: There is not enough free storage space for the print job. Restoring to factory settings can free up available space.
05004006.zh: 内部存储空间不足，可恢复出厂设置以释放所有可用空间。

05004007.en: The device requires a repair upgrade, and printing is currently unavailable.
05004007.zh: 设备需要修复升级，无法进行打印。

05004008.en: Starting printing failed; please power cycle the printer and resend the print job.
05004008.zh: 启动打印失败，请重启机器并重新发送打印。

05004009.en: Print jobs are not allowed to be sent while updating logs.
05004009.zh: 不允许在日志上传过程中发送打印任务。

0500400A.en: The file name is not supported. Please rename and restart the print job.
0500400A.zh: 文件名不支持，请修改文件名并重新发送打印。

0500400B.en: There was a problem downloading a file. Please check your network connection and resend the print job.
0500400B.zh: 文件下载错误，请检查网络并重新发送打印。

0500400C.en: Please insert a MicroSD card and restart the print job.
0500400C.zh: 请插入MicroSD卡，重新发送打印。

0500400D.en: Please run a self-test and restart the print job.
0500400D.zh: 请运行自检后重新启动打印作业。

0500400F.en: AMS is initializing and cannot be upgraded at the moment. Please try again later.
0500400F.zh: AMS 正在初始化，暂无法升级，请稍后重试。

05004010.en: AMS is drying and cannot be upgraded at the moment. Please try again later.
05004010.zh: AMS 正在烘干，暂无法升级，请稍后重试。

05004011.en: The printer is loading or unloading filament and cannot be upgraded at the moment. Please try again later.
05004011.zh: 打印机正在进退料，暂无法升级，请稍后重试。

05004012.en: The device is printing and cannot be upgraded at the moment. Please try again later.
05004012.zh: 设备正在打印，暂无法升级，请稍后重试。

05004013.en: AMS is in operation and cannot be upgraded at the moment. Please try again when it is idle.
05004013.zh: AMS 工作中，暂无法升级，请待空闲后重试。

05004014.en: Slicing for the print job failed. Please check your settings and restart the print job.
05004014.zh: 云端切片发生错误，请检查切片参数并重新发起打印。

05004015.en: There is not enough free storage space for the print job. Please format or clear files from the MicroSD card to free up space.
05004015.zh: 设备存储空间不足，无法打印。请格式化或清理SD卡以释放可用空间。

05004016.en: The MicroSD Card is write-protected. Please replace the MicroSD Card.
05004016.zh: MicroSD卡进入写保护，请更换MicroSD卡。

05004017.en: Binding failed. Please retry or restart the printer and retry.
05004017.zh: 绑定操作失败，可重试或重启打印机后重试。

05004018.en: Binding configuration information parsing failed; please try again.
05004018.zh: 绑定配置信息解析失败，请重试。

05004019.en: The printer has already been bound. Please unbind it and try again.
05004019.zh: 打印机已经绑定。请解除绑定，然后重试。

0500401A.en: Cloud access failed. Possible reasons include network instability caused by interference, inability to access the internet, or router firewall configuration restrictions. You can try moving the printer closer to the router or checking the router configuration before trying again.
0500401A.zh: 云端访问失败，可能的原因是干扰导致网络不稳定，或不具备internet访问能力， 或路由器防火墙限制。可移动打印机到路由器附近 或检测路由器配置后重试。

0500401B.en: Cloud response is invalid. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
0500401B.zh: 云端访问返回值非法，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

0500401C.en: Cloud access is rejected. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
0500401C.zh: 云端访问被拒绝，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

0500401D.en: Cloud access failed, which may be caused by network instability due to interference. You can try moving the printer closer to the router before you try again.
0500401D.zh: 云端访问失败，可能的原因是干扰导致网络不稳定，可移动打印机到路由器附近后重试。

0500401E.en: Cloud response is invalid. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
0500401E.zh: 云端访问返回值非法，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

0500401F.en: Authorization timed out. Please make sure that your phone or PC has access to the internet, and ensure that the Bambu Studio/Bambu Handy APP is running in the foreground during the binding operation.
0500401F.zh: 云端绑定授权超时，请检查手机或PC具备访问internet能力，并保证绑定操作时Bmabu Studio/Handy APP在前台执行。

05004020.en: Cloud access rejected. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
05004020.zh: 云端访问被拒绝，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

05004021.en: Cloud access failed, which may be caused by network instability due to interference. You can try moving the printer closer to the router before you try again.
05004021.zh: 云端访问失败，可能的原因是干扰导致网络不稳定，可移动打印机到路由器附近后重试。

05004022.en: Cloud response is invalid. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
05004022.zh: 云端访问返回值非法，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

05004023.en: Cloud access rejected. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
05004023.zh: 云端访问被拒绝，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

05004024.en: Cloud access failed. Possible reasons include network instability caused by interference, inability to access the internet, or router firewall configuration restrictions. You can try moving the printer closer to the router or checking the router configuration before you try again.
05004024.zh: 云端访问失败，可能的原因是干扰导致网络不稳定，或不具备互联网访问能力， 或路由器防火墙限制。可移动打印机到路由器附近 或检测路由器配置后重试。

05004025.en: Cloud response is invalid. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
05004025.zh: 云端访问返回值非法，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

05004026.en: Cloud access rejected. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
05004026.zh: 云端访问被拒绝，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

05004027.en: Cloud access failed; this may be caused by network instability due to interference. You can try moving the printer closer to the router before you try again.
05004027.zh: 云端访问失败，可能的原因是干扰导致网络不稳定，可移动打印机到路由器附近后重试。

05004028.en: Cloud response is invalid. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
05004028.zh: 云端访问返回值非法，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

05004029.en: Cloud access is rejected. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
05004029.zh: 云端访问被拒绝，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

0500402A.en: Failed to connect to the router, which may be caused by wireless interference or being too far away from the router. Please try again or move the printer closer to the router and try again.
0500402A.zh: 连接路由器失败，可能是无线环境干扰或距离路由器较远，可重试或移动打印机到路由器附近重试。

0500402B.en: Router connection failed due to incorrect password. Please check the password and try again.
0500402B.zh: 连接路由器密码错误，请检查密码后重试。

0500402C.en: Failed to obtain IP address, which may be caused by wireless interference resulting in data transmission failure or the DHCP address pool of the router being full. Please move the printer closer to the router and try again. If the issue persists, please check router settings to see whether the IP addresses have been exhausted.
0500402C.zh: 未成功获取IP地址，可能是无线环境干扰导致数据收发未成功或路由器DHCP地址池满，可移动打印机到路由器附近后重试。若多次失败需要检查路由器DHCP地址池是否已耗尽。

0500402E.en: System does not support the file system currently used by the USB flash drive. Please replace or format the USB flash drive to FAT32. / The system does not support the file system currently used by the MicroSD card. Please replace the MicroSD card or format it to FAT32.
0500402E.zh: 系统不支持SD卡当前使用的文件系统，请更换SD卡或格式化该SD卡为FAT32格式。 / 系统不支持U盘当前使用的文件系统，请更换或格式化该U盘成FAT32格式。

0500402F.en: The MicroSD card sector data is damaged. Please use the SD card repair tool to repair or format it. If it still cannot be identified, please replace the MicroSD card. / USB flash drive sector data is damaged; please format it. If it still cannot be recognized, please replace the USB flash drive.
0500402F.zh: SD卡扇区数据发生损坏，请格式化，若仍无法识别，请更换SD卡。 / U盘扇区数据发生损坏，请格式化，若仍无法识别，请更换U盘。

05004030.en: The device is currently upgrading. Please try again when it is idle.
05004030.zh: 设备正在升级，请待空闲后再试。

05004031.en: The accessory firmware does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
05004031.zh: 配件固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

05004033.en: The AMS firmware does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
05004033.zh: AMS固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

05004034.en: The Laser Module firmware does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
05004034.zh: 激光模组固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

05004035.en: The BirdsEye Camera is malfunctioning. Please try restarting the device. If the issue persists after multiple restarts, check the camera connection status or contact customer support.
05004035.zh: 俯视摄像头工作异常，请尝试重启设备。若多次重启仍未恢复，请检查摄像头连接状态或联系客服人员。

05004037.en: Your sliced file is not compatible with current printer model. This file can't be printed on this printer.
05004037.zh: 切片文件中预设机型与当前打印机型号不兼容，不能进行打印。

05004038.en: The nozzle diameter in sliced file is not consistent with the current nozzle setting. This file can't be printed.
05004038.zh: 切片文件中的喷嘴直径与当前设置不符，不能进行打印。

05004039.en: The current task does not allow the installation of the laser/cutting module, and the task has been halted.
05004039.zh: 当前任务不允许安装激光/模切模组，任务已停止。

0500403A.en: The current temperature is too low. In order to protect you and your printer, printing tasks, moving an axis and other operations are disabled. Please move the printer to an environment above 10 degrees Celsius.
0500403A.zh: 当前环境温度过低。为了保护您和打印机的安全，打印任务、轴移动等操作将被禁用。请将打印机移动到10度以上的环境使用。

0500403B.en: Laser/cutting tasks cannot be initiated on the machine at the moment. Please use the computer software to start the task.
0500403B.zh: 暂不支持在机器上发起激光/刀切任务，请使用电脑软件开始任务。

0500403C.en: The current nozzle setting does not match the slicing file. Continuing to print may affect print quality. It is recommended to re-slice before starting the print.
0500403C.zh: 当前喷嘴设置与切片文件不一致，若继续打印可能影响打印质量，建议重新切片后再开始打印。

0500403D.en: The toolhead module is not set up. Please set it up before initiating the task.
0500403D.zh: 工具头模组未初始化，请在工具头初始化后发起任务。

0500403E.en: The current tool head does not support initialization.
0500403E.zh: 当前工具头不支持进行初始化

0500403F.en: Failed to download print job; please check your network connection.
0500403F.zh: 下载打印任务失败，请检查网络连接。

05004040.en: The printer has reached its power limit. Please connect a dedicated power adapter to this AMS to enable drying.
05004040.zh: 当前打印机功率已达上限，需为此 AMS 接入独立电源适配器后，方可启动烘干。

05004041.en: The AMS drying cannot be started during printing.
05004041.zh: 打印中无法启动 AMS 烘干。

05004042.en: Printing and calibration cannot be performed while the AMS is drying. Please stop the drying process or connect a power adapter to any AMS unit not used for the current print, then try again.
05004042.zh: AMS烘干时无法执行打印、校准等操作。请停止烘干或给本次打印未使用到的AMS连接电源适配器后再次尝试。

05004043.en: Due to power limitations, only one AMS is allowed to use the device's power for drying.
05004043.zh: 由于功率限制，只允许一台AMS接设备电源烘干。

05004044.en: BirdsEye Camera malfunction: please contact customer support.
05004044.zh: 俯视摄像头功能异常，请联系售后。

05004045.en: Hotend check in progress. This operation is temporarily unavailable. Please wait.
05004045.zh: 热端检查中，当前操作暂不可用，请稍候。

05004046.en: The print has stopped because the 3MF file is invalid. Please verify that the correct printer model was selected during slicing, or update Studio and re-slice the file.
05004046.zh: 打印已停止，3MF 文件不可用。请确认切片时选择的机型是否正确，或更新 Studio 后重新进行切片。

05004047.en: The print has stopped because the available hotend quantity or model does not match the sliced file. Please verify the hotend model and quantity before restarting the print job.
05004047.zh: 打印已停止，检测到可用热端数量或型号与切片文件不匹配，请确认热端型号和数量后重新开始打印。

05004048.en: The feeder module is offline. Please check if the feeder module connection cable is loose.
05004048.zh: 进料模块离线，请检查进料模块连接线是否松动。

05004049.en: A feeder module replacement is detected. Please ensure that the corresponding extrusion gear and nozzle have been replaced, and manually update the nozzle type in the printer.
05004049.zh: 检测到进料模块更换，请确认已更换对应挤出轮和喷嘴，并在打印机上手动更新喷嘴类型。

05004050.en: Error detected on the print board.

05004051.en: Dynamic arc fitting failed. Please re-slice the model before starting the print.
05004051.zh: 检测到动态圆弧拟合失败，请重新切片后再开始打印。

05004052.en: Error detected on the hot end.

05004055.en: Using non-TPU filament with the TPU high-flow hotend may damage the hotend. Please verify filament and hotend compatibility before starting the print.
05004055.zh: 在 TPU 高流量套件中使用非 TPU 耗材可能造成热端损坏，请确认耗材与热端类型匹配后再开始打印。

05004056.en: The left extruder does not support the TPU high-flow hotend. Please install a compatible hotend and try again.
05004056.zh: 左挤出机不支持 TPU 高流量套件，请更换兼容的热端后重试。

05004057.en: The filament selected in the slicer requires a harder nozzle. Please replace the nozzle or adjust the filament settings before reprinting.
05004057.zh: 切片所选耗材需更高硬度喷嘴，当前喷嘴不符合要求。请更换喷嘴或调整耗材设置后重新开始打印。

0500405D.en: Laser module Serial Number error: unable to calibrate or make project.
0500405D.zh: 激光器序列号异常，无法标定或雕刻。

0500405F.en: BirdsEye camera not installed. Laser module calibration cannot be performed.
0500405F.zh: 未安装俯视相机，无法发起激光校准。

05004065.en: The task requires a Laser Platform, but the current one is a Cutting Platform. Please replace it, measure the material thickness in the software, and then restart the task.
05004065.zh: 此任务要求使用激光垫板，但当前正在使用刀切垫板。请将其更换，在软件中拍照测厚后重新发起任务。

05004066.en: High precision nozzle offset calibration supports PLA only. The current TPU hotend is not compatible. Please switch to a PLA-compatible hotend and try again.
05004066.zh: 高精度喷嘴偏移校准仅支持PLA耗材，当前为TPU热端，请更换支持PLA的热端后重试。

05004070.en: The laser or cutter module is connected, so the device cannot initiate a 3D printing task.
05004070.zh: 设备已接入激光/刀切模组，无法发起3D打印相关任务。

05004075.en: No Laser Platform was detected, which may affect thickness measurement accuracy. Please place the laser platform correctly and ensure the rear markers are not blocked, then restart the thickness measurement in the software before initiating the task.
05004075.zh: 未检测到激光垫板，可能影响测厚精度。请确保垫板正确放置且尾部标记未被遮挡，在软件上重新发起测厚后再开始任务。

05004076.en: Please place the Laser Platform correctly and ensure the rear markers are not blocked, then restart the thickness measurement in the software before initiating the task.
05004076.zh: 请正确放置激光垫板并确保垫板上标记可见，在软件中重新测厚后开始任务。

05004095.en: No print plate detected. Please place it correctly and recalibrate on the device.
05004095.zh: 未检测到打印板，请放置准确后在设备上重新校准。

05004097.en: The device cannot detect the Laser Module. Please reconnect the module cable or restart the printer.
05004097.zh: 设备无法识别激光模组。请拔插连接线或重启打印机。

05004098.en: The device cannot detect AMS A. Please reconnect the AMS cable or restart the printer.
05004098.zh: 设备无法识别AMS A。请拔插连接线或重启打印机。

05004099.en: The firmware of Cutting Module does not match the printer; the device cannot continue working. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
05004099.zh: 刀切模组与打印机不匹配，设备无法继续工作，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

0500409A.en: The firmware of Air Pump does not match the printer; the device cannot continue working. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
0500409A.zh: 气泵固件与打印机不匹配，设备无法继续工作，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

0500409B.en: The firmware of Laser Module does not match the printer; the device cannot continue working. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
0500409B.zh: 激光模组固件与打印机不匹配，设备无法继续工作，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

0500409D.en: The firmware of AMS A does not match the printer; the device cannot continue working. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
0500409D.zh: AMS A固件与打印机不匹配，设备无法继续工作，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

0500409E.en: The device cannot detect the Cutting Module. Please reconnect the module cable or restart the printer.
0500409E.zh: 设备无法识别刀切模组。请重新拔插连接线或重启打印机。

0500409F.en: The device cannot detect the Air Pump.  Please reconnect the module cable or restart the printer.
0500409F.zh: 设备无法识别气泵。请重新拔插连接线或重启打印机。

050040A0.en: The Rotary Attachment module is not detected. Please reconnect the cable or restart the printer.
050040A0.zh: 设备未能识别旋转轴附件，请重新插拔连接线或重启打印机。

050040A1.en: The Auto Fire Extinguishing System is not detected.  Please reconnect the module cable or restart the printer.
050040A1.zh: 设备无法识别自动灭火装置。请重新拔插连接线或重启打印机。

050040A2.en: The device cannot detect the External Exhaust Fan.  Please restart the printer or reconnect the fan cable.
050040A2.zh: 设备无法识别外部排气风扇。请重启打印机或拔插风扇连接线。

050040A3.en: AMS(or AMS Lite) A communication is abnormal. Please reconnect the module cable or restart the printer.
050040A3.zh: AMS(或AMS Lite) A 通信异常，请拔插模块连接线或重启打印机。

050040A4.en: The current firmware only supports 1 AMS Lite. Please remove all AMS units before reconnecting the supported AMS Lite device.
050040A4.zh: 当前固件仅支持连接 1台 AMS Lite，请务必先移除所有 AMS，再重新插入上述支持的设备。

050040A5.en: The current firmware only supports AMS/AMS 2 Pro/AMS HT, with a maximum of 4 units. Please remove all AMS units before reconnecting the supported one.
050040A5.zh: 当前固件仅支持 AMS / AMS 2 Pro / AMS HT，最多可连接 4 台，请务必先移除所有 AMS，再重新插入上述支持的设备。

050040A6.en: File download failed due to missing certificates. Please check the Fleet Hub certificate configuration and restart the printer before trying again
050040A6.zh: 文件下载失败，缺少证书。请检查 Fleet Hub 的证书配置，并重启打印机后重试。

050040A7.en: The device cannot detect the Filament Track Switch.  Please restart the printer or reconnect the cable.
050040A7.zh: 设备无法识别耗材变轨器。请重启打印机或拔插连接线。

050040A8.en: The device firmware requires a repair upgrade, and the current operation cannot be performed. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
050040A8.zh: 设备固件需要修复升级，无法进行当前操作，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

050040C0.en: Communication error detected with AMS, AMS Lite or AMS HT. Please reconnect the module cable or restart the printer when it is idle.
050040C0.zh: 检测到 AMS、AMS Lite 或 AMS HT 通信异常，请在打印机空闲时重新插拔模块连接线，或重启打印机。

05008013.en: The print file is not available. Please check to see if the storage media has been removed.
05008013.zh: 检测到打印文件不可用。请确认存储介质是否被移除。

05008036.en: Your sliced file is not consistent with the current printer model. Continue?
05008036.zh: 切片文件中预设机型与当前打印机型号不一致，是否继续?

0500803C.en: The current nozzle setting does not match the slicing file. Continuing to print may affect print quality. It is recommended to re-slice before starting the print.
0500803C.zh: 当前喷嘴设置与切片文件不一致，若继续打印可能影响打印质量，建议重新切片后再开始打印。

05008040.en: Toolhead front cover is detached. Moving the toolhead may damage the printer. Do you want to continue?
05008040.zh: 检测到工具头前盖脱落。移动工具头可能损坏打印机。是否继续移动？

05008041.en: The filament in hotend is too cold. Extrusion may damage the extruder. Still feeding in/out the filament?
05008041.zh: 当前热端温度较低。继续进退料可能损坏挤出机。是否仍要继续？

05008048.en: The module on the toolhead is not calibrated. Please cancel the task to perform calibration or switch to a calibrated module.
05008048.zh: 检测到当前工具头外接模组未校准，请取消任务后进行校准，或更换为已校准的模组。

05008051.en: Detected build plate is not the same as the Gcode file. Please adjust slicer settings or use the correct plate.
05008051.zh: 检测到打印板类型与切片G代码中不一致。请修改切片参数或者使用匹配的打印板。

05008053.en: Nozzle mismatch was detected during printing. Please initiate the print after re-slicing, or continue printing after replacing the correct nozzle. Caution: the hotend temperature is high. / The left and right nozzle is not matched with slicing file. Please initiate the print after re-slicing, or continue printing after replacing the correct nozzle. Caution: the hotend temperature is high.
05008053.zh: 喷嘴与切片文件所选项不匹配。请在重新切片后启动打印，或者更换正确的喷嘴后再继续打印。注意，热端温度较高，请小心操作。 / 左、右喷嘴与切片文件中的不匹配。请在重新切片后启动打印，或者更换正确的喷嘴后再继续打印。注意，热端温度较高，请小心操作。

05008054.en: The left extruder does not support the TPU high-flow hotend. Please replace it with a compatible hotend before continuing the print. Caution: the hotend is hot.
05008054.zh: 左挤出机不支持 TPU 高流量套件，请更换正确的热端后再继续打印。注意热端温度较高，请谨慎操作。

05008055.en: Laser module is installed, but a Cutting Platform is detected. Please place a Laser Platform and perform laser calibration.
05008055.zh: 设备已安装激光模组，但检测到刀切垫板。请放置激光垫板后进行激光校准。

05008056.en: Cutting module is installed, but the laser platform is detected. Please place the cutting platform for calibration.
05008056.zh: 设备已安装刀切模组，但检测到激光垫板，请放置刀切垫板后进行刀切校准。

05008057.en: The filament hardness selected in the slicer exceeds the current nozzle hardness. Continuing the print may cause nozzle wear, leading to leakage and unstable flow. Please proceed with caution.
05008057.zh: 切片所选耗材硬度超过当前喷嘴硬度，继续打印会导致喷嘴磨损，造成漏料和流量不稳，请谨慎使用。

05008058.en: Please place the light grip cutting mat correctly and ensure the marker is exposed.
05008058.zh: 请正确放置低粘性刀切垫板并确保露出标记。

05008059.en: Cutting platform base is not correctly aligned. Please ensure that the four corners of the platform are aligned with the heatbed.
05008059.zh: 刀切垫板偏移，请确保底板的四角与热床对齐

0500805A.en: Please place the cutting mat on cutting protection base.
0500805A.zh: 请在刀切保护钢板上放置粘性刀切粘板。

0500805B.en: The cutting mat type is unknown; please replace it with the correct cutting mat.
0500805B.zh: 未知的粘性刀切粘板类型，请使用正确的粘板。

0500805C.en: The grip cutting mat type does not match; please place a LightGrip cutting mat.
0500805C.zh: 刀切粘板的类型不匹配，请放置低粘性刀切粘板。

0500805E.en: Cutting module Serial Number error: unable to calibrate or make project.
0500805E.zh: 刀切模组序列号异常，无法标定或雕刻。

05008060.en: The current module on toolhead does not meet requirements. Please replace the module as per the on-screen instructions.
05008060.zh: 当前工具头上的模组不符合加工要求，请根据屏幕要求更换模组。

05008061.en: No print plate detected. Please make sure it is placed correctly.
05008061.zh: 未检测到打印板，请确认已正确放置。

05008062.en: The print plate marker was not detected. Please confirm the print plate is correctly positioned on the heatbed with all four corners aligned, and the marker is visible. If strong light is shining on the print sheet, consider closing the front door and blocking external light sources.
05008062.zh: 未检测到打印板定位标识。请确保打印板放置正确，定位标识清晰。如有强光照射打印板，建议关闭前门并适当遮挡外部光源。

05008063.en: The platform is not detected during calibration; please make sure the Laser Platform is properly placed.
05008063.zh: 校准中未检测到垫板，请确认已正确放置激光垫板。

05008064.en: Please place the Laser Platform correctly and ensure the rear markers are not blocked for laser calibration.
05008064.zh: 请正确放置激光垫板，并确保露出板上标记后，进行激光校准。

05008065.en: The left extruder does not support TPU high-flow hotend. Forced installation may cause hotend switching failure. Please replace it with another compatible hotend.
05008065.zh: 左挤出机不支持 TPU 高流量热端，强行安装将导致热端切换失败，请更换为兼容的热端。

05008066.en: The task requires a Cutting Platform, but the current one is a Laser Platform. Please replace it with a Cutting Platform (Cutting Protection Base + LightGrip cutting mat).
05008066.zh: 此任务要求使用刀切垫板，但当前正在使用激光垫板。请放置刀切垫板（刀切保护底板+低粘性刀切垫板）。

05008067.en: Please place a LightGrip cutting mat on the cutting protection base.
05008067.zh: 请在刀切保护钢板上放置低粘性刀切粘板。

05008068.en: Please place the strong grip cutting mat correctly and ensure the marker is exposed.
05008068.zh: 请正确放置高粘性刀切垫板并确保露出标记。

05008069.en: Unable to recognize the left and right hotend. It might be a non-official hotend, or the hotend mark could be dirty. Please manually set the hotend type.
05008069.zh: 无法识别左、右热端，可能使用了非官方热端，或者热端上的标记脏污。请手动设置热端类型。

0500806A.en: Unable to recognize the left and right hotend. It might be a third party hotend, or the hotend mark may be dirty. Please set hotend type on printer screen before next print.
0500806A.zh: 无法识别左、右热端，可能使用了非官方热端，或者热端上的标记脏污。请在下次打印前在打印机屏幕上手动设置热端类型。

0500806B.en: Quick-release Lever is not locked. Please press down the external toolhead module to ensure it is properly seated, then push down the level to lock it in place.
0500806B.zh: 快拆锁扣未锁定，请下压工具头外置模组，确保安装到位后向下锁紧锁扣。

0500806C.en: Please place the cutting platform correctly and ensure the marker is exposed.
0500806C.zh: 请正确放置刀切垫板并确保露出板上标记。

0500806D.en: Material not detected. Please confirm placement and continue.
0500806D.zh: 未检测到制作材料，请确认放置后继续。

0500806E.en: Foreign objects detected on heatbed; please check and clean up the heatbed.
0500806E.zh: 检测到热床上异物，请检查并清理。

0500806F.en: The grip cutting mat type does not match; please place a StrongGrip cutting mat.
0500806F.zh: 粘性刀切粘板类型不匹配，请放置高粘性刀切垫板

05008071.en: No cutting platform was detected. Please confirm that it has been correctly placed.
05008071.zh: 未检测到切割垫板，请确认已正确放置

05008072.en: The Live View Camera is obstructed. Please remove the obstruction before continuing.
05008072.zh: 实况摄像头被遮挡，请移除遮挡物后继续。

05008073.en: Heatbed limit block is obstructed or contaminated. Please clean and ensure the limit block is visible, otherwise platform position offset detection may be inaccurate.
05008073.zh: 热床限位块被遮挡或脏污，请清理确保限位块可见，否则可能导致垫板位置偏移检测错误。

05008074.en: The Laser Platform is offset. Please ensure that the four corners of the platform are aligned with the heatbed, and the marker is not obstructed.
05008074.zh: 激光垫板位置偏移，请确保底板的四角与热床对齐，并且露出板上标记。

05008077.en: The visual marker was not detected. Please ensure the paper is properly placed.
05008077.zh: 未检测到视觉标志，请确保纸张已正确放置。

05008078.en: Current material does not match the sliced file settings. Please load the correct material and ensure the QR code on the material is not damaged or dirty.
05008078.zh: 当前材料与切片中的不匹配，请放置正确的材料并确保材料上的二维码无污损。

05008079.en: Please place the Laser Test Material (350g paperboard) and position support strips underneath to prevent material warping.
05008079.zh: 请按指引放置激光测试材料（350g卡纸），并在下方垫好支撑条，防止材料翘起。

0500807A.en: The foreign object detection function is not working. You can continue the task or check the assistant for troubleshooting.
0500807A.zh: 异物检测未生效。可继续任务，或查看助手排除故障。

0500807B.en: Please place the cutting platform (cutting protection base + LightGrip cutting mat).
0500807B.zh: 请放置刀切垫板 （刀切保护钢板+低粘性刀切垫板）

0500807C.en: Please place the cutting platform (cutting protection base + StrongGrip cutting mat).
0500807C.zh: 请放置刀切垫板 （刀切保护钢板+高粘性刀切垫板）

0500807D.en: This task requires a Cutting Platform, but the current one is a Laser Platform. Please replace it with a Cutting Platform (Cutting Protection Base + StrongGrip Cutting Mat).
0500807D.zh: 此任务要求使用刀切垫板，但当前正在使用激光垫板。请放置刀切垫板（刀切保护钢板+高粘性刀切垫板）

0500807E.en: Please place a StrongGrip cutting mat on the cutting protection base.
0500807E.zh: 请在刀切保护钢板上放置高粘性刀切粘板。

05008080.en: The left and right hotend is not installed. Please install it before continuing.
05008080.zh: 左、右热端未安装，请安装后继续。

05008081.en: The left and right hotend is not installed. Please install it before continuing.
05008081.zh: 左、右热端未安装，请安装后继续。

05008082.en: Please remove the protective film on the Opaque Glossy Acrylic before processing
05008082.zh: 请撕掉亚克力板上的保护膜后再开始加工

05008083.en: Material is not allowed in Mounting Calibration. Please remove the material from the platform.
05008083.zh: 挂载校准时不允许放置制作材料，请将材料从垫板上拿走。

05008084.en: The Live View Camera is dirty; please clean it and continue.
05008084.zh: 实况摄像头脏污，请擦拭后继续。

05008086.en: Toolhead Camera is dirty, which affects the AI function; please clean the lens surface.
05008086.zh: 检测到工具头摄像头脏污，对AI功能有影响，请清洁镜头表面。

05008089.en: Task paused due to Presence Check failed. Please check the printer to continue.
05008089.zh: 因长时间未打卡，任务已暂停，请在设备屏幕上打卡后继续。

0500808A.en: The BirdsEye Camera is installed offset. Please refer to the assistant to reinstall it.
0500808A.zh: 俯视摄像头安装偏移，可查阅机器助手获得解决方案。

0500808B.en: The BirdsEye Camera setup failed. Please remove all objects and the mat on the heatbed to ensure the heatbed markers are visible. Meanwhile, please ensure the BirdsEye Camera is installed correctly and remove any obstructions that may block the camera's view.
0500808B.zh: 俯视摄像头初始化失败，请移除热床上的垫板和物体，确保热床标记可见。同时，请确保俯视摄像头安装到位，并移除可能遮挡摄像头的异物。

0500808C.en: Detected build plate offset. Please align the build plate with the heatbed, and then continue.
0500808C.zh: 检测到打印板偏移，请将打印板与热床对齐后继续。

0500808D.en: Please check whether the two cut lines next to the bottom-left marker have fully cut through the material. If they have, you may ignore this warning; if not, verify that the material is placed correctly and inspect the blade tip for possible wear.
0500808D.zh: 刀切模组偏移校准失败，请检查左下角标记旁的两条切割线是否切透材料；若已切透可忽略此告警，若未切透请确认材料放置是否正确，并检查刀尖是否存在磨损。

0500808E.en: BirdsEye Camera initialization failed. The toolhead camera did not detect the Heatbed features. Please clean the Heatbed, remove all objects and pads, and ensure the bed markings are visible. Check Assistant for a detailed solution.
0500808E.zh: 俯视摄像头初始化失败，工具头摄像头未检测到热床特征。请清理热床，移除所有物体和垫板，确保热床标记可见。可查阅机器助手获得详细解决方案。

0500808F.en: Nozzle camera lens is dirty, affecting AI monitoring. Clean the lens with a non-woven cloth and a small amount of alcohol. Beware of hotend heat; wait for it to cool before handling.
0500808F.zh: 检测到喷嘴摄像头镜头脏污，可能影响AI监控功能，请清洁镜头表面。注意热端高温，建议冷却后再操作，以防烫伤。

05008090.en: Please attach the 80g White Printing Paper to the center area of the platform.
05008090.zh: 请在垫板中间区域放置80g白色打印纸。

05008091.en: The Cutting Module offset calibration failed, which may result in inaccurate cuts. Please ensure the 80g white printer paper(letter paper thickness) is properly positioned; if the blade tip is worn, replace it. If the issue persists after checking, restart the device and try again.
05008091.zh: 刀切模组偏移校准失败，切割可能存在误差。请先确认已正确放置 80g 打印纸（相当于 A4 纸厚度）；如切割刀尖已磨损，请更换。若检查正常后问题仍存在，请重启设备后再次尝试。

05008092.en: Toolhead Camera initialization failed. This print can still continue, but some AI functions will be disabled. If you encounter this issue again after restarting, please contact customer support.
05008092.zh: 工具头摄像头初始化失败，本次打印仍可继续，但部分AI功能会失效。如果重启后尝试仍遇到此问题，请联系售后。

05008093.en: The nozzle silicone sleeve is not installed; there is a risk of temperature control failure. Please install it correctly and try again.
05008093.zh: 热端硅胶套未安装，影响温控功能，请正确安装后重试。

05008096.en: BirdsEye Camera setup failed. Please remove objects from the build plate to ensure the markers are visible, confirm the camera is properly installed, and clear any debris that may block the camera before trying again.
05008096.zh: 俯视摄像头初始化失败。请先移除垫板上的物体，确保标记清晰可见；同时确认摄像头已正确安装，并清理可能遮挡摄像头的异物后再重试。

05008097.en: BirdsEye Camera setup failed. The toolhead camera did not detect the build plate features. Please remove objects from the build plate and ensure the markers are not blocked, then try again.
05008097.zh: 俯视摄像头初始化失败，工具头摄像头未检测到垫板特征，请移除垫板上的物体，确保垫板上的标记不被遮挡。

05008098.en: No material detected. Please confirm material placement and continue.
05008098.zh: 未检测到制作材料，请确认放置后继续。

05008099.en: AI detected potential print shift or collapse. Check print status and take action. Clean build plate or apply adhesive to improve adhesion.
05008099.zh: AI监测到打印件可能移位或倒塌，请检查打印件状态并处理。请清洗打印板或涂胶以改善附着力。

0500809A.en: Please replace the Vision Encoder board with the print plate to avoid damage during calibration.
0500809A.zh: 请将视觉编码板更换为打印板，避免校准时损坏。

0500809B.en: Build plate not properly positioned, may collide with the waste chute. Please reposition build plate and align with heatbed.
0500809B.zh: 打印板未正确放置，热床抬升时可能撞击垃圾桶。请重新摆放打印板并与热床对齐。

050080A0.en: The visual encoder board was not detected. Please check if the board is properly placed and aligned at all four corners, and ensure the positioning markings are clear and free from wear.
050080A0.zh: 未检测到视觉编码器板，请检查板子是否放置且四角对齐，并保证定位标识清晰无磨损。

050080A6.en: The rotary attachment is detected. Please remove it before continuing.
050080A6.zh: 检测到已安装旋转轴附件，请将其取下后继续操作。

050080A7.en: The rotary attachment is disconnected. Please ensure it is properly installed and the cable is securely plugged in.
050080A7.zh: 检测到旋转轴附件未连接，请确认附件已正确安装并插好连接线。

0500C010.en: MicroSD Card read/write exception: please reinsert or replace the MicroSD Card. / USB flash drive read-write exception; please reinsert or replace it.
0500C010.zh: SD卡读写异常，请重新插入或更换SD卡。 / U盘读写异常，请重新插入或更换U盘。

0500C011.en: / SD card performance has degraded, which may affect printing, logging, and video. Try formatting it. If issues persist, please replace the SD card.
0500C011.zh: / SD卡性能下降，可能影响打印、日志和视频记录，请尝试格式化。若多次提示错误，请更换SD卡。

0500C032.en: Laser/Cutting module connected to the toolhead. The drying process has been automatically stopped.
0500C032.zh: 检测到工具头安装激光/刀切模组，烘干已停止。

0500C036.en: This is a printing task. Please detach the Laser/Cutting Module from the Toolhead.
0500C036.zh: 打印任务进行中，请将激光/刀切模组从工具头取下。

0500C04A.en: AMS is calibrating, reading RFID or loading/unloading material, unable to initiate drying process, please wait.
0500C04A.zh: AMS正在校准、读取RFID或进退料，无法发起烘干，请稍候。

0500C04B.en: Filament in AMS outlet, the high drying temperature may cause AMS blockage. Drying cannot be started. Please unload the filament first.
0500C04B.zh: 耗材在AMS出料口中，烘干的高温可能造成耗材在AMS出口堵塞，无法发起烘干，请先退料。

0500C04C.en: The AMS is currently drying. Please do not start the process again.
0500C04C.zh: AMS正在烘干，请勿重复发起。

0500C04D.en: The device is currently in laser or cutting mode and cannot start drying. Please do not initiate the drying process.
0500C04D.zh: 设备当前处于激光加工或刀切模式，无法启动烘干，请勿发起。

0500C04E.en: Please connect a power adapter to the AMS-HT before starting the drying process.
0500C04E.zh: 请先为 AMS-HT 连接独立电源适配器，然后再启动烘干。

0500C04F.en: The AMS is drying and cannot perform this operation at the moment.
0500C04F.zh: AMS烘干中，无法执行该操作。

0500C059.en: The device is extinguishing a fire. Please wait before operating it.
0500C059.zh: 设备灭火中，请稍后操作。

0500C07F.en: Device is busy and cannot perform this operation. To proceed, please pause or stop the current task.
0500C07F.zh: 设备正忙，暂时无法执行此操作。如需继续操作，请先暂停或停止当前任务。

0500C080.en: The extruder is currently running and cannot perform this operation. To proceed, please pause or stop the current task first.
0500C080.zh: 挤出机运行中，无法操作。如需继续，请先暂停或停止当前任务。

05014017.en: Binding failed. Please retry or restart the printer and retry.
05014017.zh: 绑定操作失败，可重试或重启打印机后重试。

05014018.en: Binding configuration information parsing failed; please try again.
05014018.zh: 绑定配置信息解析失败，请重试。

05014019.en: The printer has already been bound. Please unbind it and try again.
05014019.zh: 打印机已经绑定。请解除绑定，然后重试。

0501401A.en: Cloud access failed. Possible reasons include network instability caused by interference, inability to access the internet, or router firewall configuration restrictions. You can try moving the printer closer to the router or checking the router configuration before trying again.
0501401A.zh: 云端访问失败，可能的原因是干扰导致网络不稳定，或不具备internet访问能力， 或路由器防火墙限制。可移动打印机到路由器附近 或检测路由器配置后重试。

0501401B.en: Cloud response is invalid. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
0501401B.zh: 云端访问返回值非法，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

0501401C.en: Cloud access is rejected. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
0501401C.zh: 云端访问被拒绝，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

0501401D.en: Cloud access failed, which may be caused by network instability due to interference. You can try moving the printer closer to the router before you try again.
0501401D.zh: 云端访问失败，可能的原因是干扰导致网络不稳定，可移动打印机到路由器附近后重试。

0501401E.en: Cloud response is invalid. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
0501401E.zh: 云端访问返回值非法，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

0501401F.en: Authorization timed out. Please make sure that your phone or PC has access to the internet, and ensure that the Bambu Studio/Bambu Handy APP is running in the foreground during the binding operation.
0501401F.zh: 云端绑定授权超时，请检查手机或PC具备访问internet能力，并保证绑定操作时Bmabu Studio/Handy APP在前台执行。

05014020.en: Cloud access rejected. If you have tried multiple times and are still failing, please contact customer support.
05014020.zh: 云端访问被拒绝，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

05014031.en: Device discovery binding is in progress, and the QR code cannot be displayed on the screen. You can wait for the binding to finish or abort the device discovery binding process in the APP/Studio and retry scanning the QR code on the screen for binding.
05014031.zh: 设备发现绑定执行中，屏幕无法展现二维码。可等待局域网绑定结束，或Hand APP/Studio中止绑定，重试扫描屏幕二维码绑定。

05014032.en: QR code binding is in progress, so device discovery binding cannot be performed. You can scan the QR code on the screen for binding or exit the QR code display page on screen and try device discovery binding.
05014032.zh: 二维码绑定执行中，无法进行设备发现绑定。可扫描屏幕二维码绑定，或退出屏幕上二维码页面，尝试设备发现绑定。

05014033.en: Your APP region does not match with your printer; please download the APP in the corresponding region and register your account again.
05014033.zh: 打印区区域限制，请在对应区域的商城下载APP，注册后重试绑定。

05014034.en: The slicing progress has not been updated for a long time, and the printing task has exited. Please confirm the parameters and reinitiate printing.
05014034.zh: 切片进度长时间没有更新，打印任务退出。请确认参数并重新发起打印。

05014035.en: The device is in the process of binding and cannot respond to new binding requests.
05014035.zh: 设备正在进行绑定中，无法响应绑定请求。

05014038.en: The regional settings do not match the printer; please check the printer's regional settings.
05014038.zh: 区域设置与打印机不匹配，请检查打印机的区域设置。

05014039.en: Device login has expired; please try to bind again.
05014039.zh: 设备登录过期，请尝试重新绑定。

05014098.en: The device cannot detect AMS B. Please reconnect the AMS cable or restart the printer.
05014098.zh: 设备无法识别AMS B。请拔插连接线或重启打印机。

0501409D.en: The firmware of AMS B does not match the printer; the device cannot continue working. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
0501409D.zh: AMS B固件与打印机不匹配，设备无法继续工作，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

050140A3.en: AMS(or AMS Lite) B communication is abnormal. Please reconnect the module cable or restart the printer.
050140A3.zh: AMS(或AMS Lite) B 通信异常，请拔插模块连接线或重启打印机。

05024001.en: Current filament will be used in this print job. Settings cannot be changed.
05024001.zh: 当前耗材会在此次打印任务中使用，不允许设置。

05024002.en: Please go to “Settings > Calibration” to run the Motion Accuracy Enhancement Calibration before turning on Motion Accuracy Enhancement mode.
05024002.zh: 请前往“设置>校准”进行运动精度增强校准，才能开启运动精度增强。

05024003.en: The printer is currently printing and the motion accuracy enhancement feature cannot be turned on or off.
05024003.zh: 打印机正在打印中，无法开启或关闭运动精度增强功能。

05024004.en: Some features are not supported by the current device. Please check the Studio feature settings or update the firmware to the latest version.
05024004.zh: 选择的部分功能当前设备不支持，请检查Studio功能设置或升级固件至最新版本。

05024005.en: The AMS has not been calibrated yet, so printing cannot be initiated.
05024005.zh: AMS尚未标定完成，不能发起打印。

05024006.en: Unknown module detected, please try updating the firmware to the latest version.
05024006.zh: 检测到未知模块接入，请尝试升级固件至最新版本。

0502400D.en: Failed to start a new task: filament loading/unloading not completed.
0502400D.zh: 进退料尚未完成，无法发起新任务。

0502400E.en: Failed to start a new task: The nozzle cold pull was not completed.
0502400E.zh: 喷嘴冷拔维护尚未完成，无法发起新任务。

05024013.en: This device is not compatible with the 40W laser module. Please replace it with a 10W laser module or remove it.
05024013.zh: 当前设备不兼容40W激光模组，请更换为10W激光模组或将其移除。

05024027.en: The current AMS does not support drying while printing. Please connect to the network and update the AMS firmware on the “Firmware” page.
05024027.zh: 当前AMS不支持边烘边打，建议在“固件”页面联网更新AMS固件。

0502402D.en: Printing stopped because the printer was unable to parse the 3mf file. Please resend your print job.
0502402D.zh: 解析3mf文件遇到问题，打印已停止。请重新发送打印。

0502402E.en: Printing stopped because the printer was unable to parse the 3mf file. Please resend your print job.
0502402E.zh: 解析3mf文件遇到问题，打印已停止。请重新发送打印。

0502402F.en: Printing stopped because the printer was unable to parse the 3mf file. Please resend your print job.
0502402F.zh: 解析3mf文件遇到问题，打印已停止。请重新发送打印。

05024030.en: Failed to parse the G-code file. The task has been stopped. Please restart the G-code task.
05024030.zh: 解析 G-code 文件出错，任务已停止。请重新发起 G-code 任务。

05024098.en: The device cannot detect AMS C. Please reconnect the AMS cable or restart the printer.
05024098.zh: 设备无法识别AMS C。请拔插连接线或重启打印机。

0502409D.en: The firmware of AMS C does not match the printer; the device cannot continue working. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
0502409D.zh: AMS C固件与打印机不匹配，设备无法继续工作，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

050240A3.en: AMS(or AMS Lite) C communication is abnormal. Please reconnect the module cable or restart the printer.
050240A3.zh: AMS(或AMS Lite) C 通信异常，请拔插模块连接线或重启打印机。

0502C00F.en: The device is busy and cannot perform nozzle identification.
0502C00F.zh: 设备正忙，无法执行喷嘴识别

0502C010.en: Due to power limits, printing or calibration can’t run during AMS drying. Stop drying or connect a power adapter to continue.
0502C010.zh: 受功率限制，AMS烘干时无法进行打印、校准等操作。如需执行，请停止烘干或连接电源适配器再烘干。

0502C011.en: Currently in 2D production mode. Please continue the operation on the printer
0502C011.zh: 当前处于2D制作模式，请在打印机上完成操作。

0502C014.en: The AMS Remaining Filament Estimation is enabled by default and cannot be disabled.
0502C014.zh: AMS 剩余容量估计功能默认开启，无法关闭。

0502C024.en: The flow dynamic calibration records have exceeded the storage limit. Please delete some historical records in the slicer software before adding new calibration data.
0502C024.zh: 用户创建动态流量校准记录已超出存储上限，无法新增校准值。请在切片软件中删除部分历史记录后再添加。

0502C026.en: The device is busy with the current task and cannot perform this operation for now. Please try again later.
0502C026.zh: 设备当前任务繁忙，暂时无法执行该操作，请稍后重试。

0502C028.en: The filament currently loaded in the extruder does not support manual feeding.
0502C028.zh: 当前挤出机中的耗材不支持手动进料操作。

0502C031.en: Please check and remove any printed parts or debris from the heatbed surface before continuing the cold pull.
0502C031.zh: 请先确认热床表面无打印件或异物，再继续冷拔操作。

0502C032.en: Please check and remove any printed parts or debris from the heatbed surface and underside before continuing the drying process.
0502C032.zh: 请检查并清理热床表面及底部的打印件或异物后继续烘干。

0502C034.en: Extruder switch failed and the current action was not executed. Please go to the Extruder screen, check and complete the extruder switch, and then try again.
0502C034.zh: 挤出机切换失败，当前操作未执行。请先进入挤出机操作界面检查，完成挤出机切换后再重试。

05FE4094.en: The left hotend is not installed. Please install the hotend and recalibrate.
05FE4094.zh: 左 热端未安装，请安装后重新校准。

05FE8053.en: The left nozzle is not matched with slicing file. Please initiate the print after re-slicing, or continue printing after replacing the correct nozzle. Caution: the hotend temperature is high.
05FE8053.zh: 左喷嘴与切片文件中的不匹配。请在重新切片后启动打印，或者更换正确的喷嘴后再继续打印。注意，热端温度较高，请小心操作。

05FE8069.en: Unable to recognize the left hotend. It might be a non-official hotend, or the hotend mark could be dirty. Please manually set the hotend type.
05FE8069.zh: 无法识别左热端，可能使用了非官方热端，或者热端上的标记脏污。请手动设置热端类型。

05FE806A.en: Unable to recognize the left hotend. It might be a third party hotend, or the hotend mark may be dirty. Please set hotend type on printer screen before next print.
05FE806A.zh: 无法识别左热端，可能使用了非官方热端，或者热端上的标记脏污。请在下次打印前在打印机屏幕上手动设置热端类型。

05FE8080.en: The left hotend is not installed. Please install it before continuing.
05FE8080.zh: 左热端未安装，请安装后继续。

05FE8081.zh: 左热端未安装，请安装后继续。

05FF8081.zh: 右热端未安装，请安装后继续。

07004001.en: The AMS has been disabled for a print, but it still has filament loaded. Please unload the AMS filament and switch to the spool holder filament for printing.
07004001.zh: 检测到禁用AMS时仍从AMS加载料，请将耗材退回AMS并从料盘支架加载新料后重新发起打印。

07004025.en: Failed to read the filament information.

07008001.en: Failed to cut the filament. Please check the cutter.
07008001.zh: 检测到切料失败，请检查切刀。

07008002.en: The cutter is stuck. Please make sure the cutter handle is out.
07008002.zh: 检测到切刀卡住，请拨出刀柄后点击'重试'按钮。

07008003.en: Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. This might be caused by clogged extruder or filament broken inside the extruder.
07008003.zh: 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能堵头或耗材卡在挤出机内部。

07008004.en: AMS failed to pull back filament. This could be due to a stuck spool or the end of the filament being stuck in the path.
07008004.zh: 耗材从工具头退回AMS失败。可能是因为料盘卡住，或者耗材的端头卡在路径中。

07008005.en: The AMS failed to send out filament. You can clip the end of your filament flat, and reinsert. If this message persists, please check the PTFE tubes in AMS for any signs of wear and tear.
07008005.zh: 耗材送出AMS失败。请取出耗材后，剪平料头重新插入。如果异常继续，请检查AMS内部特氟龙管有无磨损。

07008006.en: Unable to feed filament into the extruder. The AMS may be mismatched with the extruder. You can rerun the AMS Setup. This could also be due to an entangled filament or a stuck spool. (Connect a PTFE tube if you are about to use an AMS.)
07FF8003.zh: 请将右挤出机外挂料盘的耗材拉出。如果该消息重复出现，请检查是否有耗材断在工具头。(如后续使用AMS，请连接特氟龙管） / 请将外挂料盘的耗材拉出。如果该消息重复出现，请检查是否有耗材断在工具头。(如后续使用AMS，请连接特氟龙管）

07FF8004.en: Failed to pull back the filament from the right extruder. Please check whether the filament is stuck inside the extruder. / Failed to pull back the filament from the toolhead to AMS. Please check whether the filament or the spool is stuck.
07FF8004.zh: 耗材从右挤出机退出失败，请检查耗材或料盘是否卡住。 / 耗材从工具头退回AMS失败，请检查耗材或料盘是否卡住。

07FF8005.en: Failed to feed the filament outside the AMS. Please clip the end of the filament flat and check to see if the spool is stuck.
07FF8005.zh: 耗材送出AMS失败，请剪平料头、检查料盘是否卡住。

07FF8006.en: Please feed filament into the PTFE tube of the right extruder until it can not be pushed any farther. / Please feed filament into the PTFE tube until it can not be pushed any farther.
07FF8006.zh: 请把耗材插入右挤出机进料口，直到推不动为止。 / 请把耗材插入进料口，直到推不动为止。

07FF8007.en: Please observe the nozzle of the right extruder. If the filament has been extruded, select 'Continue'; if it is not, please push the filament forward slightly, and then select 'Retry'. / Please observe the nozzle. If the filament has been extruded, select 'Continue'; if it is not, please push the filament forward slightly, and then select 'Retry'. / Please observe the nozzle. If the filament has been extruded, select 'Done'; if not, please push the filament forward slightly, and then select 'Retry'.
07FF8007.zh: 请观察右挤出机喷嘴，若耗材已被挤出，点击'继续'；若未被挤出，请往前轻推耗材后点击'重试'。 / 请观察喷嘴，若耗材已被挤出，点击'完成'；若未被挤出，请往前轻推耗材后点击'重试'。 / 请观察喷嘴，若耗材已被挤出，点击'继续'；若未被挤出，请往前轻推耗材后点击'重试'。

07FF8010.en: Check if the external filament spool or filament is stuck. / Check if the right external filament spool or filament is stuck.
07FF8010.zh: 请检查右外挂料盘或耗材是否卡住。 / 请检查外挂料盘或耗材是否卡住。

07FF8011.en: External filament has run out; please load a new filament. / The external filament connected to the right extruder has run out; please load a new filament.
07FF8011.zh: 右侧挤出机外挂料盘耗材用尽，请装入新的耗材。 / 外挂料盘耗材用尽，请装入新的耗材。

07FF8012.en: Failed to get AMS mapping table; please select 'Resume' to retry.
07FF8012.zh: 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击'继续'重试。

07FF8013.en: Timeout purging old filament of the right extruder: Please check if the filament is stuck or the extruder is clogged. / Timeout purging old filament: Please check if the filament is stuck or the extruder is clogged.
07FF8013.zh: 检测到冲刷旧料超时，请检查耗材是否卡住或挤出机堵头。 / 检测到右挤出机冲刷旧料超时，请检查耗材是否卡住或挤出机堵头。

07FF8020.en: Extruder change failed; please refer to the assistant.
07FF8020.zh: 检测到挤出机切换失败，请查看助手信息。

07FF8021.en: AMS setup failed; please refer to the assistant.
07FF8021.zh: AMS初始化失败，请查看助手信息。

07FF8024.en: Extruder position calibration failed; please refer to the assistant.
07FF8024.zh: 检测到挤出机位置校准失败，请查看助手信息。

07FF8025.en: Cold pull timed out. Please promptly operate or check whether the filament is broken inside the extruder, and click the Assistant for details.
07FF8025.zh: 喷嘴冷拔超时，请及时操作或检查耗材是否断在挤出机内，查看助手了解更多。

07FF8030.en: The filament specified in the slicer has been used up. Printing is paused. Please go to the machine to replace the material and resume printing.
07FF8030.zh: 切片中当前材料已打印完毕，打印已暂停，请前往设备更换材料后继续打印。

07FFC003.en: Please pull out the filament on the spool holder of the right extruder. If this message persists, please check to see if there is filament broken in the extruder or PTFE tube. (Connect a PTFE tube if you are about to use an AMS) / Please pull out the filament on the spool holder. If this message persists, please check to see if there is filament broken in the extruder or PTFE tube. (Connect a PTFE tube if you are about to use an AMS)
07FFC003.zh: 请将右挤出机外挂料盘的耗材拉出。如果该消息重复出现，请检查是否有耗材断在工具头。(如后续使用AMS，请连接特氟龙管） / 请将外挂料盘的耗材拉出。如果该消息重复出现，请检查是否有耗材断在工具头。(如后续使用AMS，请连接特氟龙管）

07FFC006.en: Please feed filament into the PTFE tube of the right extruder until it can not be pushed any farther. / Please feed filament into the PTFE tube until it can not be pushed any farther.
07FFC006.zh: 请把耗材插入右挤出机进料口，直到推不动为止。 / 请把耗材插入进料口，直到推不动为止。

07FFC008.en: Please pull out the filament on the spool holder of the right extruder. If this message persists, please check to see if there is filament broken in the extruder or PTFE tube. (Connect a PTFE tube if you are about to use an AMS) / Please pull out the filament on the spool holder. If this message persists, please check to see if there is filament broken in the extruder. (Connect a PTFE tube if you are about to use an AMS)
07FFC008.zh: 请将右挤出机外挂料盘的耗材拉出。如果该消息重复出现，请检查是否有耗材断在工具头。(如后续使用AMS，请连接特氟龙管） / 请将外挂料盘的耗材拉出。如果该消息重复出现，请检查是否有耗材断在工具头。(如后续使用AMS，请连接特氟龙管）

07FFC009.en: Please feed filament into the PTFE tube of the right extruder until it can not be pushed any farther. / Please feed filament into the PTFE tube until it can not be pushed any farther.
07FFC009.zh: 请把耗材插入右挤出机进料口，直到推不动为止。 / 请把耗材插入进料口，直到推不动为止。

07FFC00A.en: Please observe the nozzle of the right extruder. If the filament has been extruded, select 'Continue'; if not, please push the filament forward slightly and then select 'Retry'. / Please observe the nozzle. If the filament has been extruded, select 'Continue'; if not, please push the filament forward slightly and then select 'Retry'.
07FFC00A.zh: 请观察右挤出机喷嘴，若耗材已被挤出，点击'继续'；若未被挤出，请往前轻耗材线后点击'重试'。 / 请观察喷嘴，若耗材已被挤出，点击'继续'；若未被挤出，请往前轻推耗材后点击'重试'。

07FFC010.en: Insert the filament (over 30cm long) until it stops. You might see slight smoke during flushing. After insertion, close the front door and top cover.
07FFC010.zh: 插入耗材（长度大于30厘米）直到推不动为止。 冲刷时可能会有轻微烟雾。插入后请关闭前门和上盖。

07FFC011.en: Hold the driven wheel bracket, slowly pull the filament from the extruder, then press 'Continue'. / Please manually and slowly pull out the filament from the extruder. Then click “Continue”.
07FFC011.zh: 请从挤出机中手动缓慢拉出耗材，再点击“继续“。 / 请持续按压从动轮支架，同时从挤出机中缓慢拉出耗材，拉出后点击“继续“。

07FFC012.en: Press the black PTFE tube coupler and unplug the PTFE tube. After completing the operation, click 'Continue.' / Remove the front cover and hang it on the X-axis. Press the black PTFE tube coupler and unplug the PTFE tube. After completing the operation, click 'Continue.'
07FFC012.zh: 取下前盖并挂在X轴上，按下黑色气动接口，拔出铁氟龙管。操作后点击“继续”。 / 按下黑色气动接口，拔出铁氟龙管。操作后点击“继续”。

07FFC030.en: The filament specified in the slicer has been used up. Printing is paused. Please go to the machine to replace the material and resume printing.
07FFC030.zh: 切片中当前材料已打印完毕，打印已暂停，请前往设备更换材料后继续打印。

0C004020.en: The setup of BirdsEye Camera failed. Please clear all objects and remove the mat. Make sure the marker is not obstructed. Meanwhile, clean both the BirdsEye Camera and Toolhead Camera, and remove any foreign objects blocking their view.
0C004020.zh: 俯视摄像头初始化失败，请清空热床上的所有物体并拿开垫板。确保热床标记不被遮挡。同时，请清理俯视摄像头及工具头摄像头，并移除可能遮挡摄像头的异物。

0C004021.en: The setup of BirdsEye Camera failed; please reboot the printer.
0C004021.zh: 俯视摄像头初始化失败，请重启打印机。

0C004022.en: The setup of BirdsEye Camera failed.  Please check if the laser module is working properly.
0C004022.zh: 俯视摄像头初始化失败，请确保激光在正常工作。

0C004024.en: The Birdseye Camera is installed offset. Please refer to the assistant to reinstall it.
0C004024.zh: 俯视摄像头安装偏移，请参照Wiki重新进行安装。

0C004025.en: The Birdseye Camera is dirty. Please clean it and restart the process.
0C004025.zh: 俯视摄像头脏污，请清理后重新开始流程。

0C004026.en: The Live View Camera initialization failed; please reboot the printer.
0C004026.zh: 实况摄像头初始化失败，请重启打印机。

0C004027.en: The Live View Camera calibration failed. Please refer to the assistant for details and recalibrate the camera after processing.
0C004027.zh: 实况摄像头校准失败，请前往助手查看详细原因。处理后重新执行标定。

0C004029.en: Material not detected. Please confirm placement and continue.
0C004029.zh: 未检测到制作材料，请确认放置材料后继续。

0C00402A.en: The visual marker was not detected. Please re-paste the paper in the correct position.
0C00402A.zh: 未检测到视觉标志，请重新按正确位置粘贴纸张。

0C00402C.en: Device data link error. Please reboot the printer.
0C00402C.zh: 设备链路异常，请重启打印机。

0C00402D.en: The toolhead camera is not working properly; please reboot the device.
0C00402D.zh: 工具头摄像头工作异常，请重启设备。

0C00403D.en: The vision encoder plate was not detected. Please confirm it is correctly positioned on the heatbed.
0C00403D.zh: 未检测到视觉编码器板，请确认已正确放置。

0C00403E.en: The high-precision nozzle offset calibration has failed, possibly due to a damaged pattern or the similarity of the colors of the two selected filaments. Please clear the printed pattern and replace the filaments with higher color contrast before re-calibrating.
0C00403E.zh: 高精度喷嘴偏移校准失败，可能是图案损坏或选择的两种耗材颜色相近。请在重新尝试校准前，清除打印图案并更换颜色对比度更大的耗材。

0C004041.en: Toolhead camera calibration failed. Please ensure the Calibration Marker on the heatbed or Height Calibration Marker on the homing area is clean and undamaged, then re-run the calibration process.
0C004041.zh: 工具头摄像头校准失败，请确保高度标定贴纸或热床右上角校准贴纸清洁完好，然后重新运行校准。

0C008001.en: First layer defects were detected. If the defects are acceptable, select 'Resume' to resume the print job.
0C008001.zh: 检测到首层打印的缺陷。如果可以接受此缺陷，可点击“继续打印”按钮恢复打印任务。

0C008005.en: Purged filament has piled up in the waste chute, which may cause a tool head collision.
0C008005.zh: 检测到垃圾桶废料堆积，可能导致工具头撞料。

0C008009.en: Build plate localization marker was not found.
0C008009.zh: 未检测到打印板定位标识。

0C00800B.en: The heatbed marker was not detected. Please clear all objects and remove the mat. Make sure the marker is not obstructed.
0C00800B.zh: 未检测到热床标记，请清空热床上的所有物体并拿开垫板。确保热床标记不被遮挡。

0C008015.en: Objects detected on the platform; please clean them up in a timely manner.
0C008015.zh: 检测到垫板上存在物体，请及时清理。

0C008016.en: The foreign object detection function is not working. You can continue the task or check assistant for solutions.
0C008016.zh: 异物检测未生效。可继续任务或查看助手。

0C008017.en: Foreign objects detected on the platform; please clean them up on time.
0C008017.zh: 检测到垫板上存在异物，请及时清理。

0C008018.en: The foreign object detection function is not working. You can continue the task or view the assistant for troubleshooting.
0C008018.zh: 异物检测未生效。可继续任务或查看助手进行排故。

0C008033.en: Quick-release Lever is not locked. Please push it down to secure.
0C008033.zh: 快拆锁扣未锁定，请向下扣紧。

0C008034.en: Liveview Camera initialization failed. This print can still continue, but some AI functions will be disabled. If you encounter this issue again after restarting, please contact customer support.
0C008034.zh: 实况摄像头初始化失败，本次打印仍可继续，但部分AI功能会失效。如果重启后尝试仍遇到此问题，请联系售后。

0C00803F.en: AI detected nozzle clumping. Please check the nozzle condition. Refer to assistant for solutions.
0C00803F.zh: AI检测到热端裹头，请确认热端状况，可跳转助手查看解决方案。

0C008040.en: AI detected air-printing defect. Please check the hotend extrusion status. Refer to assistant for solutions.
0C008040.zh: AI检测到空打缺陷，请检查热端出料情况，可跳转助手查看解决方案。

0C008042.en: The AI print monitor has detected a spaghetti defect. Please check the print and take the necessary action. Cleaning the build plate or drying the filament can effectively reduce the risk of spaghetti failure.
0C008042.zh: AI检测到炒面缺陷。请检查打印件状况后做相应处理。清洗打印板、烘干耗材，可以有效降低炒面风险。

0C008043.en: AI detected nozzle clumping. Please check the nozzle condition. Refer to assistant for solutions.
0C008043.zh: AI检测到热端裹头，请确认热端状况，可跳转助手查看解决方案。

0C008053.en: The rotary attachment is placed incorrectly. Please follow the illustration to place the rotary attachment correctly, ensuring it is properly seated on the locating pins and remains level.
0C008053.zh: 旋转组件放置位置错误，请参照图示正确放置旋转组件，确保组件卡入固定销位置并保持水平。

0C008054.en: Rotary attachment positioning features were not detected. Please ensure correct placement and clear positioning markers. If confirmed, you may ignore this error and continue photo measurement.
0C008054.zh: 未检测到旋转组件的定位特征，请确认放置位置正确且定位标识清晰无磨损；如确认无误，可忽略该报错并继续拍照测量。

0C00C003.en: Possible defects were detected in the first layer.
0C00C003.zh: 检测到首层可能存在打印瑕疵。

0C00C004.en: Possible spaghetti failure was detected. Cleaning the build plate or drying the filament can effectively reduce the risk of spaghetti failure.
0C00C004.zh: 检测到可能发生了打印炒面失败问题。清洗打印板、烘干耗材，可以有效降低炒面风险。

0C00C006.en: Purged filament may have piled up in the waste chute.
0C00C006.zh: 检测到可能发生垃圾桶堆料问题。

1000C001.en: High bed temperature may lead to filament clogging in the nozzle. You may open the chamber door.
1000C001.zh: 热床温度较高，可能造成耗材软化堵头。您可打开机箱门打印。

1000C002.en: Printing CF material with stainless steel may cause nozzle damage.
1000C002.zh: 用不锈钢喷嘴打印碳纤维料可能造成喷嘴损坏。

1000C003.en: Enabling Timelapse in traditional mode may cause defects; please activate this feature as needed.
1000C003.zh: 开启传统模式的延时摄影，可能会产生表面瑕疵，请根据需要启用。

10014001.en: Timelapse is not supported as Spiral Vase mode is enabled in slicing presets.
10014001.zh: 切片参数中开启了旋转花瓶，无法支持延时摄影。

10014002.en: Timelapse is not supported as the Print sequence is set to 'By object'.
10014002.zh: 切片参数中开启了逐件打印，无法支持延时摄影。

10018003.en: The time-lapse mode is set to Traditional in the slicing file. This may cause surface defects. Would you like to enable it?
10018003.zh: 当前切片中的延时摄影为传统模式，开启延时摄影后可能会产生表面瑕疵，请确认是否开启？

10018004.en: Prime Tower is not enabled and time-lapse mode is set to Smooth in slicing file. This may cause surface defects. Would you like to enable it?
10018004.zh: 当前切片中暂未使用擦料塔，并且延时摄影的模式为平滑。开启延时摄影后可能会产生表面瑕疵，请确认是否开启？

12004001.en: Filament is still loaded from the AMS when it has been disabled. Please unload AMS filament, load from spool holder, and restart print job.
12004001.zh: 检测到禁用AMS时仍从AMS加载料，请将耗材退回AMS并从料盘支架加载新料后重新发起打印。

12008001.en: Cutting the filament failed. Please check to see if the cutter is stuck. Refer to the Assistant for solutions.
12008001.zh: 切料失败，请查看切刀是否卡住。可查看助手了解具体原因和解决方法。

12008002.en: The cutter is stuck. Please pull out the cutter handle.
12008002.zh: 检测到切刀卡住，请拨出刀柄。

12008003.en: Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. Please check whether the extruder is clogged or whether the filament is broken inside the extruder.
12008003.zh: 耗材退出挤出机失败，请检查挤出机是否堵塞或耗材是否断在挤出机内部。

12008004.en: Failed to pull back the filament from the toolhead. Please check whether the filament is stuck.
12008004.zh: 耗材从工具头退回失败，请检查耗材是否卡住。

12008005.en: The filament is not inserted. Please insert the filament.
12008005.zh: 耗材未插入，请插入耗材。

12008006.en: Unable to feed filament into the extruder. This could be due to tangled filament or a stuck spool. If not, please check if the AMS PTFE tube is connected.
12008006.zh: 耗材送往挤出机失败。可能是因为耗材缠住或料盘卡住，也可能是AMS特氟龙管未接上。

12008007.en: Failed to extrude the filament. This might be caused by clogged extruder or stuck filament. Refer to the Assistant for solutions.
12008007.zh: 耗材挤出异常，可能由堵头或耗材卡住导致。

12008010.en: AMS Lite filament spool or filament may be stuck.
12008010.zh: AMS Lite 料盘或耗材可能卡住。

12008011.en: AMS Lite filament has run out. Please insert a new filament into the same AMS slot.
12008011.zh: AMS耗材用尽。请把耗材放入同一个AMS槽位后继续。

12008012.en: Failed to get AMS mapping table; please select 'Resume' to retry.
12008012.zh: 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击'继续'重试。

12008013.en: Timeout while purging old filament. Please check if the filament is stuck or the extruder clogged.
12008013.zh: 检测到冲刷旧料超时，请检查耗材是否卡住或挤出机堵头。

12008014.en: The filament location in the toolhead was not found. Refer to the Assistant for solutions.
12008014.zh: 无法检查工具头内部的耗材位置，请查看助手进行故障排查。

12008015.en: Failed to pull out the filament from the toolhead. Please check if the filament is stuck, or if it is broken inside the extruder or PTFE tube.
12008015.zh: 耗材退出工具头失败，可能是由于耗材卡住，或者断在挤出机或特氟龙管中。

12008016.en: The extruder is not extruding normally. Refer to the Assistant for troubleshooting. There may be defects in this layer, but you may resume if the defects are acceptable.
12008016.zh: 检测到挤出机无法挤出耗材，请查看助手排除故障。可能在这层出现打印缺陷，如果接受请继续打印。

12014001.en: Filament is still loaded from the AMS when it has been disabled. Please unload AMS filament, load from spool holder, and restart print job.
12014001.zh: 检测到禁用AMS时仍从AMS加载料，请将耗材退回AMS并从料盘支架加载新料后重新发起打印。

12018001.en: Failed to cut the filament. Please check the cutter.
12018001.zh: 检测到切料失败，请检查切刀。

12018002.en: The cutter is stuck. Please pull out the cutter handle.
12018002.zh: 检测到切刀卡住，请拨出刀柄。

12018003.en: Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. Please check whether the extruder is clogged or whether the filament is broken inside the extruder.
12018003.zh: 耗材退出挤出机失败，请检查挤出机是否堵塞或耗材是否断在挤出机内部。
