0300190000010001.en: The eddy current sensor on Y-axis is not available; the wire is probably broken.
0300190000010001.zh: Y轴涡流传感器没有读到数据，可能线路断路。

0300190000020002.en: The sensitivity of the Y-axis eddy current sensor is too low. Please remove any foreign objects on the Y-axis linear rail.
0300190000020002.zh: Y轴涡流传感器灵敏度偏低，请清除Y轴线轨上的异物。

03001A0000020001.en: The nozzle is covered with filament, or the build plate is crooked.
03001A0000020001.zh: 喷嘴被耗材包裹或打印板放歪。

03001A0000020002.en: The nozzle is clogged with filament.

03001B0000010001.en: The signal of the heatbed acceleration sensor is weak. The sensor may have fallen off or been damaged.
03001B0000010001.zh: 热床加速度传感器信号弱，可能是传感器脱落或已受损。

03001B0000010002.en: External disturbance was detected on the heatbed acceleeration sensor. The sensor signal wire may not be affixed.
03001B0000010002.zh: 热床加速度传感器检测到外部干扰，可能传感器信号线未固定。

03001B0000010003.en: The heatbed acceleration sensor detected unexpected continuous force. The sensor may be stuck, or the analog front end may be broken.
03001B0000010003.zh: 热床加速度传感器检测到异常持续外力，可能是传感器被卡住或发生了电路损坏。

03001C0000010001.en: The extrusion motor driver is abnormal. The MOSFET may have a short circuit.
03001C0000010001.zh: 挤出电机驱动异常，可能是开关管短路。

03001D0000010001.en: The position sensor of extrusion motor is abnormal. The connection to the sensor may be loose.
03001D0000010001.zh: 挤出电机位置传感器异常，可能是传感器排线松动。

03001D000001000A.en: Extruder motor overload detected. The motor may be faulty.
03001D000001000A.zh: 挤出电机过载，可能是电机故障。

03001E0000010001.en: The left nozzle temperature is abnormal; the heater may have a short circuit.
03001E0000010001.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，加热器可能短路。

03001E0000010002.en: The left nozzle temperature is abnormal; the heater may have an open circuit.
03001E0000010002.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，加热器可能开路。

03001E0000010003.en: The left nozzle temperature is abnormal; the heater is overheated.
03001E0000010003.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，加热器过温。

03001E0000010005.en: Abnormal temperature control detected on the left extruder nozzle; the heating module may be damaged. Please disconnect the power immediately and stop using the device, and contact customer support for troubleshooting guidance.
03001E0000010005.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，可能为加热模块损坏。请立即断开设备电源并停止使用，联系售后获取排故指引。

03001E0000010006.en: The left nozzle temperature is abnormal; the sensor may have a short circuit, please check whether the connector is properly plugged in.
03001E0000010006.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，温度传感器可能短路，请检查连接器是否插好。

03001E0000010007.en: The left nozzle temperature is abnormal; the sensor may have an open circuit.
03001E0000010007.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，温度传感器可能开路。

03001E0000010008.en: The left extruder nozzle temperature is abnormal and cannot reach the set value. This may be caused by an improperly installed nozzle silicone sock.
03001E0000010008.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温度异常，无法加热至设定值，可能是喷嘴硅胶套未正确安装。

03001E0000010009.en: The left nozzle temperature control is abnormal; the hot end may not be installed. If you want to heat the hot end without it being installed, please turn on maintenance mode.
03001E0000010009.zh: 左挤出机喷嘴温控异常，热端可能未安装。若需在热端未安装时也能加热，请打开维护模式。

0300200000010001.en: X-axis homing abnormal: please check if the toolhead is stuck or if the resistance on the X-axis linear rail is too high. / X-axis homing abnormal: please check if the toolhead is stuck or the carbon rod resistance is too high.
0300200000010001.zh: X轴回零异常，请检查是否工具头被卡住或X轴导轨阻力过大。 / X轴回零异常，请检查是否工具头被卡住或碳管阻力过大。

0300200000010002.en: Y axis homing abnormal: Please check if the heatbed is stuck or if the motion resistance is too high. / Y-axis homing abnormal: please check if the toolhead is stuck or the Y carriage has too much resistance.
0300200000010002.zh: Y轴回零异常，请检查是否工具头被卡住或Y滑车阻力过大。 / Y轴回零异常，请检查热床是否卡住或运动阻力过大。

0300200000010003.en: X axis homing abnormal: the timing belt may be loose.
0300200000010003.zh: X轴回零异常，可能是同步带松了。

0300200000010004.en: Y axis homing abnormal: the timing belt may be loose.
0300200000010004.zh: Y轴回零异常，可能是同步带松了。

0300250000010001.en: Low signal frequency detected on the right extruder eddy current sensor. The nozzle may not be installed, or the nozzle heat sink may be too far away from the sensor.
0300250000010001.zh: 右挤出机涡流传感器信号频率过低，可能喷嘴未安装或喷嘴散热片距离传感器过远。

0300250000010002.en: Low sensitivity detected in the right extruder eddy current sensor. Check the nozzle installation.
0300250000010002.zh: 右挤出机涡流传感器灵敏度偏低，喷嘴可能未正确安装。

0300250000010003.en: Unable to read data from the right extruder eddy current sensor; there may be a communication break or sensor damage.
0300250000010003.zh: 无法读取右挤出机涡流传感器数据，可能遇到通信断路或者传感器损坏。

0300250000010004.en: The eddy current sensor signal of the right extruder is abnormal. The sensor may be damaged, or the MC-TH communication may be abnormal.
0300250000010004.zh: 右侧挤出机的涡流传感器信号异常，可能传感器已损坏或MC-TH通信异常。

0300250000010005.en: Z-axis motor rotation is obstructed; please check if foreign objects are stuck in the Z slider or Z timing pulley. Also, ensure the build plate is placed correctly to avoid collisions with surrounding structures.
0300250000010005.zh: Z轴电机转动受阻，请检查Z滑块和Z同步带轮是否有异物卡住，或热床打印板是否放置不正导致与周边结构发生碰撞。

0300250000010007.en: High signal frequency detected on the right extruder eddy current sensor. The sensor may be damaged, or the nozzle heat sink may be too close to the sensor.
0300250000010007.zh: 右挤出机涡流传感器信号频率过高，可能传感器已损坏或喷嘴散热片距离传感器过近。

0300250000010008.en: The right nozzle touches the heating bed abnormally. Please check whether there is filament residue on the nozzle, foreign matter at the point where the nozzle contacts the bed, or severe deformation of the flow blocker.
0300250000010008.zh: 右侧喷嘴触碰热床异常，请检查喷嘴是否有耗材残留，触碰位置是否有异物，或堵嘴弹片是否严重变形。

030025000001000A.en: Nozzle offset calibration failed. Filament sticks to the nozzle, which may affect print quality. Please clean the nozzle and try again.
030025000001000A.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准失败。检测到喷嘴粘料，可能影响打印质量。请清理喷嘴后重试。

030025000001000B.en: Nozzle presence detection failed: Right extruder nozzle not installed or improperly installed.
030025000001000B.zh: 喷嘴在位检测失败：右挤出机喷嘴未安装或安装不到位。

030025000001000C.en: An anomalous jump in the right extruder eddy current sensor data has been detected, potentially caused by poor sensor contact or a faulty sensor.
030025000001000C.zh: 检测到右挤出机涡流传感器数据异常跳变，可能是传感器接触不良或损坏。

0300260000010001.en: Low signal frequency detected on the left extruder eddy current sensor. The sensor may be installed too far, or the sensor may be loose.
0300260000010001.zh: 左挤出机涡流传感器信号频率过低，可能传感器安装位置过远或传感器已松脱。

0300260000010002.en: Left extruder eddy current sensor sensitivity is low. Check sensor installation.
0300260000010002.zh: 左挤出机涡流传感器灵敏度偏低，涡流传感器可能未正确安装。

0300260000010003.en: Unable to read data from the left extruder eddy current sensor; there may be a communication break or sensor damage.
0300260000010003.zh: 无法读取左挤出机涡流传感器数据，可能遇到通信断路或者传感器损坏。

0300260000010004.en: The eddy current sensor signal of the left extruder is abnormal. The sensor may be damaged, or the MC-TH communication may be abnormal.
0300260000010004.zh: 左侧挤出机的涡流传感器信号异常，可能传感器已损坏或MC-TH通信异常。

0300260000010005.en: Z-axis motor rotation is obstructed; please check if foreign objects are stuck in the Z slider or Z timing pulley. Also, ensure the build plate is placed correctly to avoid collisions with surrounding structures.
0300260000010005.zh: Z轴电机转动受阻，请检查Z滑块和Z同步带轮是否有异物卡住，或热床打印板是否放置不正导致与周边结构发生碰撞。

0300260000010007.en: High signal frequency detected on the left extruder eddy current sensor. The sensor may be installed too close, or the sensor may be loose.
0300260000010007.zh: 左挤出机涡流传感器信号频率过高，可能传感器安装位置过近或传感器已松脱。

0300260000010008.en: The left nozzle touches the heating bed abnormally. Please check whether there is filament residue on the nozzle, foreign matter at the point where the nozzle contacts the bed, or severe deformation of the flow blocker.
0300260000010008.zh: 左侧喷嘴触碰热床异常，请检查喷嘴是否有耗材残留，触碰位置是否有异物，或堵嘴弹片是否严重变形。

030026000001000B.en: Nozzle presence detection failed: Left extruder nozzle not installed or improperly installed.
030026000001000B.zh: 喷嘴在位检测失败：左挤出机喷嘴未安装或安装不到位。

030026000001000C.en: An anomalous jump in the left extruder eddy current sensor data has been detected, potentially caused by poor sensor contact or a faulty sensor.
030026000001000C.zh: 检测到左挤出机涡流传感器数据异常跳变，可能是传感器接触不良或损坏。

0300270000010001.en: The nozzle offset calibration sensor frequency is too low. The sensor may be damaged.
0300270000010001.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准传感器频率过低，可能传感器已损坏。

0300270000010002.en: Too many attempts at nozzle offset calibration, possibly due to purged filament between the nozzle and the heated base, or incorrect installation of the nozzle. Please inspect and retry.
0300270000010002.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准尝试次数过多，可能是喷嘴与加热底座之间有残余废料，或是喷嘴没有正确安装，请检查后重试校准。

0300270000010003.en: The nozzle offset calibration result shows significant deviation, possibly due to the heat insulation sheet on the right nozzle heating base not being installed. Please install it correctly and try again.
0300270000010003.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准结果差异过大，可能是右热端加热底座的隔热片没有安装，请检查并安装隔热片后重新进行校准。

0300270000010004.en: The signal of the nozzle offset calibration sensor is abnormal. The sensor may be damaged, or the wiring may not be connected properly.
0300270000010004.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准传感器信号异常，可能传感器已损坏或接线松动。

0300270000010005.en: The nozzle offset calibration indicates significant deviation, possibly caused by an additional heat insulation sheet installed on the right nozzle heating base. Please verify this and attempt the calibration again.
0300270000010005.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准结果差异过大，可能是右热端加热底座的隔热片多安装了一片，请确认无误后重试校准。

0300270000010006.en: The nozzle offset calibration shows significant deviation, possibly due to incorrect installation of the nozzle or heating base. Please inspect and retry.
0300270000010006.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准结果差异过大，可能喷嘴或加热底座没有正确安装，请检查后重试校准。

0300270000010007.en: The nozzle offset calibration sensor frequency is too high. The sensor may be damaged.
0300270000010007.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准传感器频率过高，可能传感器已损坏。

0300270000010008.en: The nozzle offset calibration sensor signal is too weak. It may be that the nozzle is sticky or the nozzle does not move above the sensor during calibration, causing the distance between the nozzle and the sensor to be too far.
0300270000010008.zh: 喷嘴偏移校准传感器信号过弱，可能是喷嘴粘料或喷嘴在校准时没有运动到传感器上方，导致喷嘴与传感器的距离太远。

0300280000010001.en: The data of the force sensor of the Cutting Module is abnormal. The magnet on the Tool Holder may fall off or the force sensor may be damaged.
0300280000010001.zh: 刀切模组力传感器数据异常，可能刀架上的磁铁脱落或者力传感器已经损坏。

0300280000010003.en: Communication failure between cutting module and toolhead during Z-axis homing. Please check if the cutting module signal cable is loose or broken or verify if the force sensor coil is intact.
0300280000010003.zh: Z轴回零过程中，刀切模组与工具头通信失败，请检查刀切模组信号线是否松动断裂，或检查力传感器线圈是否完好。

0300280000010004.en: The force sensor of the Cutting Module is abnormal. The force sensor cable may be disconnected or the force sensor is damaged.
0300280000010004.zh: 刀切模组力传感器出现异常。可能是力传感器线缆脱落或力传感器损坏。

0300280000010005.en: Z-axis homing failed in cutting mode. Please check if there are any foreign objects in the Z-axis slider and Z-axis synchronous pulley.
0300280000010005.zh: 刀切模式Z轴回零失败，请检查Z滑块、Z同步带轮是否有异物。

0300280000010007.en: Communication failure between the Cutting Module and toolhead module. Please check if the Cutting module signal cable is loose or broken. It could also be due to a broken force sensor coil.
0300280000010007.zh: 刀切模组与工具头通信失败，请检查刀切模组信号线是否松动断裂，或检查力传感器线圈是否完好。

0300280000010008.en: Z-axis homing failed. Please check if the blade holder movement is smooth and ensure no foreign objects are at the contact position on the heatbed.
0300280000010008.zh: Z轴回零失败，请检查刀架运动是否顺畅，并确保热床接触位置无异物。

0300290000010001.en: Vision encoder patterns can not be recognized; possible reasons include vision encoder pattern distortion, light overexposure, and plate misplacement.
0300290000010001.zh: 视觉编码板图案识别异常，可能原因有：图案变形或破损、光源过曝、编码板摆放不对等。

03002B0000020001.en: Air-door calibration failed. Please check if there is any foreign object blocking the damper.
03002B0000020001.zh: 风门标定失败，请检查风门是否有异物卡住。

03002C0000010001.en: Obstacle detected under the heatbed. Please remove it to ensure proper printing.
03002C0000010001.zh: 热床底部存在障碍物影响打印，请清除障碍物。

03002D0000010006.en: Heated bed leveling failed, possibly due to foreign objects on the bed or bed tilt. Continuing to print may damage the build plate. Please remove any debris or manually level the bed before retrying.
03002D0000010006.zh: 热床调平失败，可能由于热床上有异物或热床倾斜。继续打印可能损坏打印板，请清理异物或手动调平热床后重试。

03002D0000030009.zh: 正在执行首次高温热床调平

03002E0000030001.en: The motor noise cancellation feature needs to be updated; please recalibrate.
03002E0000030001.zh: 电机降噪功能更新，请重新校准。

0300310000010001.en: The Part Cooling Fan speed is too slow or stopped. It may be stuck, or the connector may not be plugged in properly.
0300310000010001.zh: 部件冷却风扇转速过低或停转，可能被杂物卡住或连接器未插好。

0300310000020002.en: The Part Cooling Fan speed is slow. It may be stuck and need cleaning.
0300310000020002.zh: 部件冷却风扇转速偏低，可能有杂物堆积导致转速偏低。

0300320000010001.en: The Auxiliary Part Cooling Fan speed is too slow or stopped. It may be stuck, or the connector may not be plugged in properly. / The Right Side (Auxiliary Component Cooling-Filtration) Fan speed is too slow or stopped. It may be stuck, or the connector may not be plugged in properly.
0300320000010001.zh: 右侧(辅助部件冷却-过滤)风扇转速过低或停转，可能被杂物卡住或连接器未插好。 / 辅助部件冷却风扇转速过低或停转，可能被杂物卡住或连接器未插好。

0300320000010002.en: The Right Side (Auxiliary Component Cooling-Filtration) Fan speed is slow. It may be stuck and need cleaning.
0300320000010002.zh: 右侧(辅助部件冷却-过滤)风扇转速转速偏低，可能有杂物堆积导致转速偏低。

0300320000020002.en: The Auxiliary Part Cooling Fan speed is slow. It may be stuck and need cleaning.
0300320000020002.zh: 辅助部件冷却风扇转速偏低，可能有杂物堆积导致转速偏低。

0300330000010001.en: The Chamber Exhaust Fan speed is too slow or stopped. It may be stuck, or the connector may not be plugged in properly.
0300330000010001.zh: 腔体外排风扇转速过低或停转，可能被杂物卡住或连接器未插好。

0300330000020002.en: The Chamber Exhaust Fan speed is slow. It may be stuck and need cleaning.
0300330000020002.zh: 腔体外排风扇转速偏低，可能有杂物堆积导致转速偏低。

0300350000010001.en: The MC module cooling fan speed is too slow or stopped. It may be stuck, or the connector may not be plugged in properly.
0300350000010001.zh: MC模块散热风扇转速过低或停转，可能被杂物卡住或连接器未插好。

0300350000020002.en: The MC module cooling fan speed is slow. It may be stuck and need cleaning.
0300350000020002.zh: MC模块散热风扇转速偏低，可能有杂物堆积导致转速偏低。

0300360000010001.en: The Chamber Heat Circulation Fan speed is too slow or stopped. It may be stuck, or the connector may not be plugged in properly.
0300360000010001.zh: 腔温加热循环风扇转速过低或停转，可能被杂物卡住或连接器未插好。

0300360000020002.en: The Chamber Heat Circulation Fan speed is slow. It may be stuck and need cleaning.
0300360000020002.zh: 腔温加热循环风扇转速偏低，可能有杂物堆积导致转速偏低。

0300390000010001.en: The Toolhead Enhanced Cooling Fan is running too slowly or has stopped, possibly due to debris blockage or a loose connector.
0300390000010001.zh: 工具头散热增强风扇转速过低或停转，可能被杂物卡住或连接器未插好。

0300390000020002.en: The Toolhead Enhanced Cooling Fan is running at a low speed, possibly due to debris buildup.
0300390000020002.zh: 工具头散热增强风扇转速偏低，可能有杂物堆积导致转速偏低。

03003A0000010001.en: The Left Side Auxiliary Component Cooling Fan speed is slow. It may be stuck and need cleaning.
03003A0000010001.zh: 左侧辅助部件冷却风扇转速过低或停转，可能被杂物卡住或连接器未插好。

03003A0000020002.en: The Left Side Auxiliary Component Cooling Fan speed is slow. It may be stuck and need cleaning.
03003A0000020002.zh: 左侧辅助部件冷却风扇转速转速偏低，可能有杂物堆积导致转速偏低。

0300400000020001.en: Data transmission over the serial port is abnormal; the software system may be faulty.
0300400000020001.zh: 通过串行端口传输数据异常；软件系统可能有故障。

0300400000020002.en: G-code data error detected. The system has automatically reloaded the G-code and resumed printing.
0300400000020002.zh: 检测到 G-code 数据异常，系统已自动重新获取并继续打印。

0300410000010001.en: The system voltage is unstable. Triggering the power failure protection function.
0300410000010001.zh: 系统电压不稳定，触发断电保护功能。

0300420000010001.en: Toolhead power abnormality detected; it may be caused by a damaged TH board or a short circuit in the USB-C cable.
0300420000010001.zh: 工具头电源异常，可能是TH板损坏或USB-C线短路。

0300900000010001.en: Chamber heating failed. The heater may not be blowing hot air.
0300900000010001.zh: 腔温加热失败，腔温加热器热风产出可能异常。

0300900000010002.en: Chamber heating failed. Possible causes: the chamber is not fully enclosed, ambient temperature is too low, or the power supply heat dissipation vent is blocked.
0300900000010002.zh: 腔温加热失败。可能是因为舱门未关闭，或者外界温度过低。

0300900000010003.en: Chamber heating failed. The power supply temperature may be too high.
0300900000010003.zh: 腔温加热失败，电源可能出现过热。

0300900000010004.en: Chamber heating failed. The speed of the heating fan is too low.
0300900000010004.zh: 腔温加热失败，加热风扇转速过低。

0300900000010005.en: Chamber heating failed. The thermal resistance is too high.
0300900000010005.zh: 腔温加热失败，加热链路热阻过大。

0300900000010007.en: High chamber temperature detected. If the hotend is overheating or emitting smoke, immediately power off the printer. Please refer to the Wiki for detailed troubleshooting instructions.
0300900000010007.zh: 检测到腔温过高，如出现热端过热或冒烟现象，请立即关闭电源。请前往 Wiki 查看详细的排查与处理指南。

0300900000010010.en: The communication of chamber temperature controller is abnormal.

0300910000010001.en: The temperature of chamber heater 1 is abnormal. The heater may have a short circuit.
0300910000010001.zh: 腔温加热器1温控异常，加热器可能短路。

0300910000010002.en: The temperature of chamber heater 1 is abnormal. The heater may have an open circuit or the thermal fuse may have burned out.
0300910000010002.zh: 腔温加热器1温控异常，加热器可能开路或热保险丝断开。

0300910000010003.en: The temperature of chamber heater 1 is abnormal. The heater is over temperature.
0300910000010003.zh: 腔温加热器1温控异常，加热器过温。

0300910000010005.en: A chamber heater temperature control issue has been detected and the heating module may be damaged. Please power off the device immediately and follow the Wiki to replace the AC board.
0300910000010005.zh: 腔温加热器温控异常，加热器超温，请立即断开设备电源并停止使用。参考Wiki更换AC板。

0300910000010006.en: The temperature of chamber heater 1 is abnormal. The sensor may have a short circuit.
0300910000010006.zh: 腔温加热器1温控异常，温度传感器可能短路。

0300910000010007.en: The temperature of chamber heater 1 is abnormal. The sensor may have an open circuit.
0300910000010007.zh: 腔温加热器1温控异常，温度传感器可能开路。

0300910000010008.en: The chamber heater 1 failed to reach the target temperature.

030091000001000A.en: The temperature of chamber heater 1 is abnormal. The AC board may be broken.
030091000001000A.zh: 腔温加热器1温控异常，AC板可能故障。

030091000001000C.en: The chamber heater 1 has worked at full load for a long time. The temperature control system may be abnormal.
030091000001000C.zh: 腔温加热器1长时间满载工作，温控系统可能异常。

030091000001000E.en: The power supply voltage does not match the machine; chamber heater 1 has been disabled.
030091000001000E.zh: 检测到电源电压与机器不匹配，腔温加热器1已禁用

0300920000010001.en: The temperature of chamber heater 2 is abnormal. The heater may have a short circuit.
0300920000010001.zh: 腔温加热器2温控异常，加热器可能短路。

0300920000010002.en: The temperature of chamber heater 2 is abnormal. The heater may have an open circuit or the thermal fuse may be in effect.
0300920000010002.zh: 腔温加热器2温控异常，加热器可能开路或热保险丝断开。

0300920000010003.en: The temperature of chamber heater 2 is abnormal. The heater is over temperature.
0300920000010003.zh: 腔温加热器2温控异常，加热器过温。

0300920000010006.en: The temperature of chamber heater 2 is abnormal. The sensor may have a short circuit.
0300920000010006.zh: 腔温加热器2温控异常，温度传感器可能短路。

0300920000010007.en: The temperature of chamber heater 2 is abnormal. The sensor may have an open circuit.
0300920000010007.zh: 腔温加热器2温控异常，温度传感器可能开路。

0300920000010008.en: The chamber heater 2 failed to reach the target temperature.

030092000001000A.en: The temperature of chamber heater 2 is abnormal. The AC board may be broken.
030092000001000A.zh: 腔温加热器2温控异常，AC板可能故障。

0300930000010001.en: Chamber temperature is abnormal. The chamber heater's temperature sensor may have a short circuit.
0300930000010001.zh: 腔温异常，加热器温度传感器可能短路。

0300930000010002.en: Chamber temperature is abnormal. The chamber heater's temperature sensor may have an open circuit.
0300930000010002.zh: 腔温异常，加热器温度传感器可能开路。

0300930000010003.en: Chamber temperature is abnormal. The chamber heater's temperature sensor at the air outlet may have a short circuit.
0300930000010003.zh: 腔温异常，出风口温度传感器可能短路。

0300930000010004.en: Chamber temperature is abnormal. The chamber heater's temperature sensor at the air outlet may have an open circuit.
0300930000010004.zh: 腔温异常，出风口温度传感器可能开路。

0300930000010005.en: Chamber temperature is abnormal. The chamber heater's temperature sensor at the air inlet may have a short circuit. / Chamber temperature is abnormal. The chamber temperature sensor may have a short circuit.
0300930000010005.zh: 腔温异常，腔体温度传感器可能短路。 / 腔温异常，进风口温度传感器可能短路。

0300930000010006.en: Chamber temperature is abnormal. The chamber heater's temperature sensor at the air inlet may have an open circuit. / Chamber temperature is abnormal. The chamber temperature sensor at the air inlet may have an open circuit.
0300930000010006.zh: 腔温异常，腔体温度传感器可能开路。 / 腔温异常，进风口温度传感器可能开路。

0300930000010007.en: Chamber temperature is abnormal. The temperature sensor at the power supply may have a short circuit.
0300930000010007.zh: 腔温异常，电源温度传感器可能短路。

0300930000010008.en: Chamber temperature is abnormal. The temperature sensor at power supply may have an open circuit.
0300930000010008.zh: 腔温异常，电源温度传感器可能开路。

0300940000020003.en: Chamber failed to reach the desired temperature. The machine will stop waiting for the chamber temperature.
0300940000020003.zh: 腔温未能达到预期，已退出腔温等待并开始后续工作。

0300940000030001.en: Chamber cooling may be too slow. You can open the front door or top cover to help cooling if the air in the chamber is non-toxic.
0300940000030001.zh: 腔体散热可能过慢。如腔内气体无害，可打开前门和上盖辅助散热。

0300940000030002.en: Chamber temperature setting value exceed the limit, the boundary value will be set.
0300940000030002.zh: 腔温设置超出边界，将使用边界值。

0300950000010001.en: The temperature sensor of the Laser Module may have a short circuit.
0300950000010001.zh: 激光模组温度传感器可能短路。

0300950000010002.en: The temperature sensor of the Laser Module may have an open circuit.
0300950000010002.zh: 激光模组温度传感器可能开路。

0300950000010004.en: The speed of the Laser Module cooling fan is too low or stopped. It may be stuck or the connector may not be plugged in properly.
0300950000010004.zh: 激光模组的散热风扇转速过低或停转,可能被杂物卡住或连接器未插好。

0300950000010005.en: The Laser Module communication is abnormal; please check the connector.
0300950000010005.zh: 激光模组通信断连，请检查连接器。

0300950000010006.en: Laser Module not detected: the module may have fallen off, or the quick-release lever may not be locked.
0300950000010006.zh: 激光模组在位检测异常，可能是模组脱落或快拆锁扣没锁紧。

0300950000010007.en: The engraving laser module is abnormal; the laser may have an open circuit or may be damaged.
0300950000010007.zh: 雕刻激光模组异常，激光器可能开路或损坏。

0300950000010008.en: The Laser Module communication is abnormal; please check the connector.
0300950000010008.zh: 激光模组通信断连，请检查连接器。

0300950000010009.en: The ambient temperature sensor at the bottom of the laser module is abnormal; the sensor is short-circuited.
0300950000010009.zh: 激光模组底部环温传感器异常，传感器短路。

030095000001000A.en: The ambient temperature sensor at the bottom of the laser module is abnormal; the sensor has an open circuit.
030095000001000A.zh: 激光模组底部环温传感器异常，传感器开路。

0300960000010001.en: The front door seems to be open; the task has been paused.
0300960000010001.zh: 检测到前门打开，任务暂停。

0300960000010002.en: The front door Hall sensor (Upper) is abnormal; please check whether the connection wire is loose.
0300960000010002.zh: 前门霍尔传感器（上）异常，请检查连接排线是否松动。

0300960000010003.en: The front door Hall sensor (Lower) is abnormal; please check whether the connection wire is loose. / The front door Hall sensor is abnormal; please check whether the connection wire is loose.
0300960000010003.zh: 前门霍尔传感器异常，请检查连接排线是否松动。 / 前门霍尔传感器（下）异常，请检查连接排线是否松动。

0300960000010004.en: The Front Laser Safety Window is not detected. Please install it according to the Wiki and re-initiate the task.
0300960000010004.zh: 检测到前门激光防护视窗未安装，请按Wiki安装好后重新发起任务。

0300970000010001.en: The top cover seems to be open; the task has been paused
0300970000010001.zh: 检测到上盖打开，任务暂停

0300970000010002.en: The top cover Hall sensor (Front Right) is abnormal; please check whether the connection wire is loose.
0300970000010002.zh: 顶盖霍尔传感器（右前）异常，请检查连接排线是否松动。

0300970000010003.en: The top cover Hall sensor (Rear Left) is abnormal; please check whether the connection wire is loose.
0300970000010003.zh: 顶盖霍尔传感器（左后）异常，请检查连接排线是否松动。

0300970000010004.en: The Top Laser Protection Plate is not detected. Please install it according to the Wiki and re-initiate the task.
0300970000010004.zh: 检测到顶部防护板未安装，请按Wiki安装好后重新发起任务。

0300980000010001.en: The left side window seems to be open, the task has been paused.
0300980000010001.zh: 检测到左侧窗打开，任务暂停

0300980000010002.en: The left side window Hall sensor (Upper) is abnormal; please check whether the connection wire is loose.
0300980000010002.zh: 左侧窗霍尔传感器（上）异常，请检查连接排线是否松动。

0300980000010003.en: The left side window Hall sensor (Lower) is abnormal; please check whether the connection wire is loose.
0300980000010003.zh: 左侧窗霍尔传感器（下）异常，请检查连接排线是否松动。

0300980000010004.en: The Left Laser Safety Window is not detected. Please install it according to the Wiki and re-initiate the task.
0300980000010004.zh: 检测到左激光防护视窗未安装，请按Wiki安装好后重新发起任务。

0300980000030001.en: The left side window seems to be open.

0300990000010001.en: The right side window seems to be open; the task has been paused.
0300990000010001.zh: 检测到右侧窗打开，任务暂停。

0300990000010002.en: The right side window Hall sensor (Lower) is abnormal; please check whether the connection wire is loose.
0300990000010002.zh: 右侧窗霍尔传感器（下）异常，请检查连接接线是否松动。

0300990000010003.en: The right side window Hall sensor (Upper) is abnormal; please check whether the connection wire is loose.
0300990000010003.zh: 右侧窗霍尔传感器（上）异常，请检查连接接线是否松动。

0300990000010004.en: The Right Laser Safety Window is not detected. Please install it according to the Wiki and re-initiate the task.
0300990000010004.zh: 检测到右激光防护视窗未安装，请按Wiki安装好后重新发起任务。

0300990000030001.en: The right side window is detected to be open.

03009B0000010001.en: Emergency stop button is not installed. Please follow the Wiki to install it.
03009B0000010001.zh: 未安装急停按钮，请按照Wiki正确安装。

03009B0000010002.en: Safety key is not inserted. Please follow the Wiki to install it.
03009B0000010002.zh: 未插入安全钥匙，请按照Wiki正确安装。

03009B0000010003.en: Emergency Stop Button is not in the right position. Please follow the Wiki to install it.
03009B0000010003.zh: 未将急停按钮安装到位，请按照Wiki正确安装。

03009C0000010001.en: The Air Pump is not detected. Please check whether the connector is plugged in properly.
03009C0000010001.zh: 未检测到气泵，请检查连接器是否插好。

03009C0000010002.en: The Air Pump is abnormal and may be damaged.
03009C0000010002.zh: 气泵工作异常，该模块可能损坏。

03009D0000020001.en: The engrave laser focal point XY calibration has failed. Please clean up the Laser Homing Area on the Laser Platform, and re-run the Laser Module Mount Calibration.
03009D0000020001.zh: 雕刻激光器的焦点XY标定失败，请将激光垫板回零台清洁干净后，重新执行激光模组挂载校准后，进行重试。

03009D0000020002.en: The engrave laser focal point XY calibration result differs significantly from the design values. Please re-install the Laser Module and re-run the Laser Module Setup.
03009D0000020002.zh: 雕刻激光器焦点XY标定结果与设计值偏差较大，建议重新安装激光模组并重新运行一次激光模组首次安装初始化。

03009D0000020003.en: The engrave laser focal point Z calibration result differs significantly from the design values. Please re-install the Laser Module and re-run the Laser Module Setup. If it fails repeatedly, please get in touch with customer support.
03009D0000020003.zh: 雕刻激光器焦点Z标定结果与设计值偏差较大，建议重新安装激光模组并重新运行一次激光模组首次安装初始化。如果多次失败，请联系我们的售后团队。

03009E0000030001.en: Open Door Detection level for this print job will be set as 'Notification'.
03009E0000030001.zh: 本次打印的开门检测功能将设置为“通知”级别。

0300A10000010001.en: Chamber temperature is too high. Please open the top cover and front door to cool down, or lower the ambient temperature.
0300A10000010001.zh: 腔体温度过高，请打开上盖和前门降温，或降低环境温度。

0300A20000010001.en: MC module temperature is too high, possibly because of high chamber temperature of the printer. You can try lowering the environmental temperature before use.
0300A20000010001.zh: MC模块温度过高，可能是因为打印机背部散热受限，建议调整打印机位置或降低环境温度后再使用。

0300A40000010001.en: Heatbed temperature is too high. Please wait for it to cool down to room temperature before restarting the task.
0300A40000010001.zh: 热床温度过高，请等待温度降至室温后重新发起任务。

0300A40000010002.en: Hotend temperature is too high. Please wait for it to cool down to room temperature before restarting the task. / The right hotend temperature is too high. Please wait for it to cool down to room temperature before restarting the task.
0300A40000010002.zh: 右热端温度过高，请等待温度降至室温后重新发起任务。 / 热端温度过高，请等待温度降至室温后重新发起任务。

0300A40000010003.en: The left hotend temperature is too high. Please wait for it to cool down to room temperature before restarting the task.
0300A40000010003.zh: 左热端温度过高，请等待温度降至室温后重新发起任务。

0300A40000010004.en: Chamber temperature is too high. Please wait for it to cool down to room temperature before restarting the task.
0300A40000010004.zh: 腔体温度过高，请等待温度降至室温后重新发起任务。

0300A40000010005.en: The heatbed temperature sensor is abnormal. Please troubleshoot the issue before restarting the task.
0300A40000010005.zh: 热床温度传感器异常，请排查故障后发起任务。

0300A40000010008.en: The chamber temperature sensor is abnormal. Please troubleshoot the issue before restarting the task.
0300A40000010008.zh: 腔温温度传感器异常，请排查故障后发起任务。

0300A50000010001.en: Flame Sensor 1 is abnormal. The sensor may be short-circuited.
0300A50000010001.zh: 火焰传感器1异常，传感器可能短路。

0300A50000010002.en: Flame Sensor 2 is abnormal. The sensor may be short-circuited.
0300A50000010002.zh: 火焰传感器2异常，传感器可能短路。

0300A50000010003.en: Flame Sensor 3 is abnormal. The sensor may be short-circuited.
0300A50000010003.zh: 火焰传感器3异常，传感器可能短路。

0300A50000010004.en: Flame Sensor 4 is abnormal. The sensor may be short-circuited.
0300A50000010004.zh: 火焰传感器4异常，传感器可能短路。

0300A50000010005.en: Flame Sensor 5 is abnormal. The sensor may be short-circuited.
0300A50000010005.zh: 火焰传感器5异常，传感器可能短路。

0300A60000010001.en: The Toolhead Enhanced Cooling Fan is not properly installed; it may not be securely fastened or may have fallen off.
0300A60000010001.zh: 工具头散热增强风扇没有安装到位，可能未扣紧或已经脱落。

0300A60000010002.en: The Toolhead Enhanced Cooling Fan has lost communication; please check the connector.
0300A60000010002.zh: 工具头散热增强风扇通信断连，请检查连接器。

0300A70000030001.en: The chamber temperature is high or air filtration is enabled. The system has automatically increased exhaust fan speed and noise may rise. If filtration is not enabled, open the front door/top cover or lower the ambient temperature.
0300A70000030001.zh: 当前腔体温度较高或过滤已开启，系统已自动提高外排风扇转速，噪音可能增大。如未启用过滤，请打开前门/上盖或降低环境温度。

0300A80000010001.en: AMS power supply abnormality, possibly due to AMS damage or a short circuit in the AMS interface, or too many AMS connections. Please check if it is correctly connected.
0300A80000010001.zh: AMS电源异常，可能是AMS损坏、AMS接口短路，或AMS接入数量过多。请检查AMS接入是否正确。

0300AD0000030001.en: Chamber temperature is high; the filter function has been automatically turned off to prevent a printing pause.
0300AD0000030001.zh: 腔温较高，为避免打印暂停，过滤功能已自动关闭。

0300C00000010001.en: Active Chamber Exhaust air door malfunction: it may be stuck.
0300C00000010001.zh: 自动排气格栅动作异常，可能卡住。

0300C00000010002.en: Filter Switch Flap air door malfunction: it may be stuck.
0300C00000010002.zh: 过滤切换风门动作异常，可能卡住。

0300C00000010003.en: Automatic Top Vent air door malfunction: it may be stuck.
0300C00000010003.zh: 顶部自动风门动作异常，可能卡住。

0300C10000010001.en: Airflow System failed to activate cooling mode; please check the air door status.
0300C10000010001.zh: 风道无法进入冷却模式，请检查风门状态。

0300C10000010002.en: Airflow System failed to activate heating mode; please check the air door status.
0300C10000010002.zh: 风道无法进入腔温保持模式，请检查风门状态。

0300C10000010003.en: Airflow System failed to activate laser mode; please check the air door status.
0300C10000010003.zh: 风道无法进入激光模式，请检查风门状态。

0300C20000010002.en: Hall sensor of Filter Switch Flap malfunction: please check if the wiring is loose.
0300C20000010002.zh: 过滤切换风门霍尔传感器异常，可能是风门排线松动。

0300C30000010001.en: Current sensor of Active Chamber Exhaust malfunction: this may be due to an open circuit or a hardware sampling circuit fault.
0300C30000010001.zh: 自动排气格栅电流传感器异常，可能是风门排线松动或硬件采样电路故障。

0300C30000010002.en: Current sensor of Filter Switch Flap malfunction: this may be due to an open circuit or a hardware sampling circuit fault.
0300C30000010002.zh: 过滤切换风门电流传感器异常，可能是风门排线松动或硬件采样电路故障。

0300C30000010003.en: Current sensor of Automatic Top Vent malfunction: this may be due to open circuit or a hardware sampling circuit fault.
0300C30000010003.zh: 顶部自动风门电流传感器异常，可能是风门排线松动或硬件采样电路故障。

0300D00000010001.en: The cutting module base has fallen off; please reinstall it.
0300D00000010001.zh: 刀切模组脱落，请重新安装。

0300D00000010002.en: The blade holder has fallen off; please reinstall it.
0300D00000010002.zh: 刀切刀架掉落，请重新安装。

0300D00000010003.en: The cutting module cable has come loose; please check the cable connection.
0300D00000010003.zh: 刀切模组连接线脱落，请检查。

0300D10000010001.en: Fire extinguisher motor has an open-circuit. There may be a loose connection, or the motor may have failed.
0300D10000010001.zh: 灭火器电机断路，可能是电机连接器没插紧或电机故障。

0300D10000010002.en: Fire extinguisher motor error. Please power off and then power on to restart the extinguisher.
0300D10000010002.zh: 灭火器电机异常，请断开灭火器电源后重新上电。

0300D30000020001.en: Fire extinguisher not detected. Please ensure the signal cable is securely connected and the plug is fully inserted.
0300D30000020001.zh: 灭火器未连接，请确认灭火器已上电且4pin信号线连接牢固。

0300D40000010002.en: The fire extinguisher presence detection sensor is malfunctioning. Please check if the sensor cable is loose or damaged.
0300D40000010002.zh: 灭火器在位检测传感器异常，请检查传感器连接线是否松动或损坏。

0300D50000020004.en: Fire extinguisher cylinder not installed. Please confirm on the extinguisher page.
0300D50000020004.zh: 灭火器气瓶未安装，请前往灭火器页面确认。

0300D50000020005.en: The Fire Extinguisher Gas Cylinder is empty. Please replace the gas cylinder and then confirm the replacement on the Auto Fire Extinguishing System page.
0300D50000020005.zh: 灭火器气瓶已耗尽，请及时更换气瓶。若已更换气瓶，请在自动灭火装置页进行确认。

0300D60000010006.en: Fire extinguisher motor reset failed. Please power off and then power on to restart the extinguisher.
0300D60000010006.zh: 灭火器电机复位失败，请断开灭火器电源后重新上电。

0300D60000010007.en: The fire extinguisher motor reset is jammed. Please gently turn the emergency handwheel left and right until the resistance decreases. Then, power off the fire extinguisher and turn it back on.
0300D60000010007.zh: 灭火器电机复位卡滞，请小幅度左右拧动应急手轮直至阻力变小，断开灭火器电源后重新上电。

0300D70000010003.en: The workpiece on the rotary attachment collided with the toolhead. Please replace it with a properly sized workpiece and try again. See the Wiki for supported size ranges.
0300D70000010003.zh: 检测到激光旋转轴上的加工物体与工具头发生碰撞，请更换合适尺寸的加工物体后重试，支持的加工物体尺寸范围详见 Wiki。

0300D70000020001.en: The rotary attachment is disconnected. Please ensure it is properly installed and the cable is securely plugged in.
0300D70000020001.zh: 检测到激光旋转轴附件未连接，请确认附件已正确安装并插好连接线。

0300D70000020002.en: The rotary attachment is detected. Please remove it before continuing.
0300D70000020002.zh: 检测到已安装旋转轴附件，请将其取下后继续操作。

0300D80000010001.en: The rotary attachment motor has an open-circuit. There may be a loose connection, or the motor may have failed.
0300D80000010001.zh: 检测到激光旋转轴的电机断路，可能是电机连接器没插紧或电机故障。

0300D80000010002.en: The rotary attachment motor error. Please power off and then power on to restart the rotary attachment.
0300D80000010002.zh: 检测到激光旋转轴的电机异常，请断开激光旋转轴电源后重新上电。

0300D90000020001.en: Communication error between the rotary attachment motor and the position sensor. If restarting fails, please contact customer support.
0300D90000020001.zh: 检测到激光旋转轴的电机与位置传感器通信异常。如重启打印机无法解决问题，请联系售后服务。

0300DB0000020001.en: Laser module detected. Please install the right nozzle correctly to ensure proper Laser Module Mounting Calibration.
0300DB0000020001.zh: 已检测到激光模组，请正确安装右喷嘴，以确保后续激光模组挂载校准正常。

0500010000020001.en: The media pipeline is malfunctioning. Please restart the printer. If multiple attempts fail, please contact customer support.
0500010000020001.zh: 媒体链路错误。请重启机器，如多次尝试失败请联系客服。

0500010000020002.en: Live View camera is not connected. Please check the hardware and cable connections.
0500010000020002.zh: 未连接实况摄像头，请检查硬件及线路连接。

0500010000030004.en: Not enough space on MicroSD Card. Video recording and timelapse recording cannot be performed. Please clear some space. / Not enough space on the USB flash drive. Video recording and timelapse recording cannot be performed. Please clear some space.
0500010000030004.zh: MicroSD卡空间不足，可能无法进行录像或者延时摄影，请删除MicroSD卡中部分文件。 / U盘空间不足，可能无法进行录像或者延时摄影，请删除U盘中部分文件。

0500010000030005.en: The Micro SD card is in Read-Only mode. Video recording and Timelapse recording cannot be performed. Please refer to the Wiki for assistance. / The USB drive is in Read-Only mode. Video recording and Timelapse recording cannot be performed. Please refer to the Wiki for assistance.
0500010000030005.zh: 当前SD卡处于只读模式，无法进行录像和Timelapse录制，请参考Wiki处理。 / 当前U盘处于只读模式，无法进行录像和Timelapse录制，请参考Wiki处理。

0500010000030006.en: The USB drive is not formatted or cannot be written; please format the USB drive. / Unformatted MicroSD Card: please format it.
0500010000030006.zh: MicroSD卡未格式化，请格式化MicroSD卡。 / U盘未格式化或无法写入，请格式化U盘。

0500010000030007.en: No MicroSD card detected. The liveview camera cannot record a time-lapse. / No USB drive detected. The liveview camera cannot record a time-lapse.
0500010000030007.zh: 没有插入MicroSD卡，无法用实况相机录制延时摄影。 / 没有插入U盘，无法用实况相机录制延时摄影。

0500010000030015.en: The printer’s internal storage is low and timelapse recording may fail. Please delete files from the internal storage to free up space, then try recording again.
0500010000030015.zh: 机内存储空间不足，可能无法录制延时摄影。请先清理机内存储中的文件，释放空间后再尝试录制。

0500020000020001.en: Failed to connect to the internet. Please check the network connection.
0500020000020001.zh: 设备连接服务器失败，请检查网络连接。

0500020000020002.en: Device login failed; please check your account information.
0500020000020002.zh: 账号登录失败，请检查账号信息。

0500020000020003.en: Failed to connect to the internet; please check the network connection.
0500020000020003.zh: 无法连接互联网；请检查网络连接。

0500020000020004.en: Unauthorized user: please check your account information.
0500020000020004.zh: 未经授权的用户：请检查您的账户信息。

0500020000020005.en: Failed to connect to the internet; please check the network connection.
0500020000020005.zh: 无法连接互联网；请检查网络连接。

0500020000020006.en: Streaming function error. Please check the network and try again. You can restart or update the printer if the issue persists.
0500020000020006.zh: 流媒体服务异常，检查网络后重试。如仍未恢复，可重启或更新打印机。

0500020000020007.en: Liveview service login failed; please check your network connection.
0500020000020007.zh: 流媒体服务登录失败，请检查网络连接。

0500030000010001.en: The MC module is malfunctioning; please restart the device or check device cable connection.
0500030000010001.zh: MC模块工作异常，请尝试重启设备。请检查排线连接。

0500030000010002.en: The toolhead is malfunctioning. Please restart the device.
0500030000010002.zh: 工具头模块工作异常，请尝试重启设备。

0500030000010003.en: The AMS module is malfunctioning. Please restart the device.
0500030000010003.zh: AMS模块工作异常，请尝试重启设备。

0500030000010004.en: The Filament Buffer module is malfunctioning. Please restart the device.
0500030000010004.zh: 缓冲器模块工作异常，请重启设备。

0500030000010005.en: Internal service is malfunctioning. Please restart the device.
0500030000010005.zh: 内部服务异常，请重启设备。

0500030000010006.en: A system panic occurred. Please restart the device.
0500030000010006.zh: 系统崩溃，需要断电重启。

0500030000010007.en: The Toolhead expansion module is malfunctioning. Please power off, check the connection, and restart the device.
0500030000010007.zh: 工具头拓展模块工作异常，请断电排查线路连接情况，并重启设备。

0500030000010008.en: A system hang occurred. Please restart the device.
0500030000010008.zh: 系统出现卡死，需要断电重启。

0500030000010009.en: A system hang occurred. It has been recovered by automatic restart.
0500030000010009.zh: 系统出现卡死，已自动重启恢复。

050003000001000A.en: System state is abnormal; please restore to factory settings.
050003000001000A.zh: 系统状态异常，请恢复出厂设置。

050003000001000B.en: The screen is malfunctioning; please restart the device.
050003000001000B.zh: 屏幕出现故障；请重新启动设备。

050003000001000C.en: The MC motor controller module is malfunctioning. Please power off, check the connection, and restart the device.
050003000001000C.zh: MC电机控制器工作异常，请断电排查线路连接情况，并重启设备。

050003000001000E.en: Some external modules are incompatible with the printer's firmware version, which may affect normal operation. Please go to the 'Firmware' page while connected to the internet to upgrade.
050003000001000E.zh: 检测到部分配件与打印机固件版本不匹配，可能影响正常使用。请在联网状态下前往“固件”页面进行升级。

0500030000010021.en: Hardware incompatible; please check the Micro Lidar. / Hardware incompatible; please check the Toolhead Camera.
0500030000010021.zh: 硬件不兼容，请检查工具头相机。 / 硬件不兼容，请检查激光雷达。

0500030000010023.en: The Chamber Temperature Control module is malfunctioning. Please restart the device.
0500030000010023.zh: 腔温控制器工作异常，请重启设备。

0500030000010024.en: The current temperature is too low. In order to protect you and your printer, printing tasks, moving an axis and other operations are disabled. Please move the printer to an environment above 10 degrees Celsius.
0500030000010024.zh: 当前环境温度过低。为了保护您和打印机的安全，打印任务、轴移动等操作将被禁用。请将打印机移动到10度以上的环境使用。

0500030000010025.en: The current firmware version is abnormal and printing cannot start. Please ensure the printer is connected to the network and go to the “Firmware” page to update.
0500030000010025.zh: 当前固件版本异常，无法发起打印。请确保打印机已联网，并前往“固件”页面完成升级。

0500030000010026.en: The Toolhead expansion module is malfunctioning. Please power off, check the connection, and restart the device.
0500030000010026.zh: 工具头拓展模块工作异常，请断电排查线路连接情况，并重启设备。

050003000002000C.en: Wireless hardware error: please turn off/on WiFi or restart the device.
050003000002000C.zh: 网络硬件异常，请关闭/开启WIFi或者重启设备。

050003000002000D.en: The SD Card controller is malfunctioning.

050003000002000E.en: Some modules are incompatible with the printer's firmware version, which may affect use. Please go to the 'Firmware' page to update after connected to the internet, or you may update offline according to wiki.
050003000002000E.zh: 检测到部分配件与打印机固件版本不匹配，可能影响正常使用。请在联网后前往“固件”页面进行升级。也可查看wiki进行离线升级。

0500030000020020.en: Micro SD Card capacity is insufficient to cache print files. / USB flash drive capacity is insufficient to cache print files.
0500030000020020.zh: SD卡容量不足，无法缓存打印文件。 / U盘存储容量不足，无法缓存打印文件。

0500030000020055.en: User information has expired, please log in again.
0500030000020055.zh: 用户信息已过期，请重新登录账号。

0500030000030022.en: MicroSD Card performance degradation has been detected. It may affect print jobs, logs, and video records. Please format or change the MicroSD card.
0500030000030022.zh: MicroSD卡读写速率低，可能影响打印性能。

0500040000010001.en: Failed to download print job; please check your network connection.
0500040000010001.zh: 下载打印任务失败，请检查网络连接。

0500040000010002.en: Failed to report print state; please check your network connection.
0500040000010002.zh: 打印状态上传错误，请检查网络连接。

0500040000010003.en: The content of print file is unreadable; please resend the print job.
0500040000010003.zh: 打印文件异常，请重新启动打印。

0500040000010025.en: Abnormal connection between AMS/AMS Lite and the device is detected. Please refer to the Wiki for adjustment.
0500040000010025.zh: 检测到AMS/AMS Lite与设备的连接方式异常，请参考Wiki进行调整。

0500040000010044.en: The firmware of AMS A does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
0500040000010044.zh: AMS A固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

0500040000010046.en: The firmware of Laser Module does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
0500040000010046.zh: 激光模组固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

0500040000010047.en: The firmware of Air Pump does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
0500040000010047.zh: 气泵固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

0500040000010048.en: The firmware of Cutting Module does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
0500040000010048.zh: 刀切模组固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

0500040000010049.en: Communication error detected with AMS, AMS Lite or AMS HT. Please reconnect the module cable or restart the printer when it is idle.
0500040000010049.zh: 检测到 AMS、AMS Lite 或 AMS HT 通信异常，请在打印机空闲时重新插拔模块连接线，或重启打印机。

050004000001004F.en: Unknown module detected, please try updating the firmware to the latest version.
050004000001004F.zh: 检测到未知模块接入，请尝试升级固件至最新版本。

0500040000010051.en: Emergency Stop Button is not in the right position. Please follow the Wiki to install it.
0500040000010051.zh: 急停按钮未正确安装，请按照Wiki正确安装。

0500040000010052.en: Safety Key is not inserted. Please follow the Wiki to install it.
0500040000010052.zh: 未插入安全钥匙，请按照Wiki正确安装。

0500040000020007.en: The bed temperature exceeds the filament's vitrification temperature, which may cause a nozzle clog. Please keep the front door of the printer open or lower the bed temperature.
0500040000020007.zh: 热床温度超过了耗材丝的软化温度，可能造成堵塞。请保持打印机的前门打开或者降低热床温度。

0500040000020010.en: The RFID-tag on AMS A Slot1 cannot be identified.
0500040000020010.zh: 无法识别AMS A料卷1的标签内容。

0500040000020011.en: The RFID-tag on AMS A Slot2 cannot be identified.
0500040000020011.zh: 无法识别AMS A料卷2的标签内容。

0500040000020012.en: The RFID-tag on AMS A Slot3 cannot be identified.
0500040000020012.zh: 无法识别AMS A料卷3的标签内容。

0500040000020013.en: The RFID-tag on AMS A Slot4 cannot be identified.
0500040000020013.zh: 无法识别AMS A料卷4的标签内容。

0500040000020014.en: The RFID-tag on AMS B Slot1 cannot be identified.
0500040000020014.zh: 无法识别AMS B料卷1的标签内容。

0500040000020015.en: The RFID-tag on AMS B Slot2 cannot be identified.
0500040000020015.zh: 无法识别AMS B料卷2的标签内容。

0500040000020016.en: The RFID-tag on AMS B Slot3 cannot be identified.
0500040000020016.zh: 无法识别AMS B料卷3的标签内容。

0500040000020017.en: The RFID-tag on AMS B Slot4 cannot be identified.
0500040000020017.zh: 无法识别AMS B料卷4的标签内容。

0500040000020018.en: The RFID-tag on AMS C Slot1 cannot be identified.
0500040000020018.zh: 无法识别AMS C料卷1的标签内容。

0500040000020019.en: The RFID-tag on AMS C Slot2 cannot be identified.
0500040000020019.zh: 无法识别AMS C料卷2的标签内容。

050004000002001A.en: The RFID-tag on AMS C Slot3 cannot be identified.
050004000002001A.zh: 无法识别AMS C料卷3的标签内容。

050004000002001B.en: The RFID-tag on AMS C Slot4 cannot be identified.
050004000002001B.zh: 无法识别AMS C料卷4的标签内容。

050004000002001C.en: The RFID-tag on AMS D Slot1 cannot be identified.
050004000002001C.zh: 无法识别AMS D料卷1的标签内容。

050004000002001D.en: The RFID-tag on AMS D Slot2 cannot be identified.
050004000002001D.zh: 无法识别AMS D料卷2的标签内容。

050004000002001E.en: The RFID-tag on AMS D Slot3 cannot be identified.
050004000002001E.zh: 无法识别AMS D料卷3的标签内容。

050004000002001F.en: The RFID-tag on AMS D Slot4 cannot be identified.
050004000002001F.zh: 无法识别AMS D料卷4的标签内容。

0500040000020030.en: The BirdsEye Camera is not installed. Please power off printer and then install the camera.
0500040000020030.zh: 俯视摄像头未安装，请断电后参考说明书安装。

0500040000020031.en: Before using a Laser/Cutting Module, the pose of the BirdsEye Camera needs to be determined. Please complete the setup to calibrate the camera.
0500040000020031.zh: 在使用激光/刀切模组前，需要确定俯视摄像头的位置和姿态。请点击“初始化”来校准俯视摄像头。

0500040000020032.en: Please slide in Laser Module and lock the quick-release lever.
0500040000020032.zh: 请插入激光模组并锁紧快拆锁扣。

0500040000020033.en: Please plug in the module connector.

0500040000020034.en: Laser module detected for the first time. Complete the setup (~4 min) before use for precise cutting and engraving. Also, ensure the H2.0 screw at the back securing the air pump is removed.
0500040000020034.zh: 检测到激光组件首次接入。为确保激光雕刻精度，请在使用前进行初始化，预计耗时约 4 分钟。同时，请确认已拆除打印机背部的 H2.0 气泵螺钉。

0500040000020035.en: The Laser Module needs calibration to get the focus position. Please perform mounting calibration before use. (about 2 minutes)
0500040000020035.zh: 激光组件需要校准，以获取精确的焦点位置。请在使用前执行挂载校准。耗时大约2分钟。

0500040000020036.en: New Cutting Module connected. To ensure more precise cutting, please set it up before use. (about 3 minutes)
0500040000020036.zh: 检测到刀切模组首次接入。为了切割更加精确，请在使用前初始化。耗时约3分钟。

0500040000020037.en: The Cutting Module needs calibration to get the tool position. Please perform the mounting calibration before use. (about 2-4 minutes)
0500040000020037.zh: 刀切模组需要校准，以获取精确的刀尖位置。请在使用前执行挂载校准。耗时约2-4min。

0500040000020038.en: Please slide in cutting module and fasten the quick release lever. If already installed, the module might not be properly aligned. Please try reinstalling it.
0500040000020038.zh: 请安装刀切模组并锁紧快拆锁扣。如已安装，可能是模组没有滑入到位，请尝试重新安装。

0500040000020039.en: Please plug in the module connector

0500040000020040.en: The TPU-specific hotend is not compatible with the left extruder. Please replace it with another compatible hotend.
0500040000020040.zh: TPU高流量套件与左挤出机不兼容，请更换其他兼容的热端。

0500040000020041.en: The laser module has been used for a long time. Please clean it promptly to avoid affecting laser processing.
0500040000020041.zh: 当前激光模组使用时间较长，请及时清理烟尘，避免影响激光加工。

0500040000020042.en: The Live View Camera is dirty or obstructed; please clean it and continue.
0500040000020042.zh: 实况摄像头脏污或被遮挡，请清理后继续。

0500040000020043.en: The Toolhead Camera is dirty or obstructed; please clean it and continue.
0500040000020043.zh: 工具头摄像头脏污或被遮挡，请清理后继续。

0500040000020050.en: Laser Safety Window is not installed.

0500040000030008.en: The door seems to be open.
0500040000030008.zh: 检测到打印过程中开门。

0500040000030009.en: The bed temperature exceeds filament's vitrification temperature, which may cause nozzle clog. Please keep the front door of the printer open. Door open detection has been temporarily turned off.
0500040000030009.zh: 热床温度超过了耗材丝的软化温度，可能造成堵塞。请保持打印机的前门打开，本次打印已经临时关闭了开门检测功能。

0500040000030054.en: Auto Fire Extinguishing System detected. It is recommended to conduct a Fire Drill to become familiar with the operation process.
0500040000030054.zh: 检测到自动灭火系统已接入，建议进行一次灭火演练，熟悉操作流程。

0500040000030057.en: The print job has been completed. Automatic air purification is in progress.
0500040000030057.zh: 打印任务完成，自动空气净化中。

0500050000010001.en: The factory data of the AP board is abnormal; please replace the AP board with a new one.
0500050000010001.zh: AP板出厂数据异常，请更换新AP板。

0500050000010006.en: The factory data of AP board is abnormal; please replace the AP board with a new one.
0500050000010006.zh: AP板出厂数据异常，请更换新AP板。

0500050000010007.en: MQTT Command verification failed. Please update Studio (including the network plugin) or Handy to the latest version, then restart the software and try again.
0500050000010007.zh: MQTT 命令校验失败。请更新 Studio（含网络插件）或 Handy 至最新版本，并重启软件后重试。

050005000001000D.en: The BirdsEye Camera is malfunctioning. Please try restarting the device. If the issue persists after multiple restarts, check the camera connection status or contact customer support.
050005000001000D.zh: 俯视摄像头工作异常，请尝试重启设备。若多次重启仍未恢复，请检查摄像头连接状态或联系客服人员。

050005000001000E.en: Laser Module firmware does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
050005000001000E.zh: 激光模组固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

050005000001000F.en: The accessory firmware does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
050005000001000F.zh: 配件固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

0500050000010010.en: The firmware of AMS A does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
0500050000010010.zh: AMS A固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

0500050000010011.en: The Air Pump firmware does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
0500050000010011.zh: 气泵固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

0500050000010012.en: The Cutting Module firmware does not match the printer. Please upgrade it on the 'Firmware' page.
0500050000010012.zh: 刀切模组固件与打印机不匹配，请到“固件”页面进行升级。

0500050000010013.en: Laser module certification failed. Please reconnect the cable or restart the printer.
0500050000010013.zh: 激光模组认证失败，请拔插连接线或重启打印机。

0500050000010014.en: AMS A certification failed. Please reconnect the cable or restart the printer.
0500050000010014.zh: AMS A 认证失败，请拔插连接线或重启打印机。

0500050000010015.en: Air Pump certification failed. Please reconnect the cable or restart the printer.
0500050000010015.zh: 气泵认证失败，请拔插连接线或重启打印机。

0500050000010016.en: Cutting module certification failed. Please reconnect the cable or restart the printer.
0500050000010016.zh: 刀切模组认证失败，请拔插连接线或重启打印机。

0500050000010018.en: The Rotary Attachment module certification failed. Please reconnect the cable or restart the printer.
0500050000010018.zh: 旋转轴附件模块认证失败，请拔插模块连接线或重启打印机。

0500050000010019.en: The Auto Fire Extinguishing System certification failed. Please reconnect the module cable or restart the printer.
0500050000010019.zh: 自动灭火装置模块认证失败，请拔插模块连接线或重启打印机。

050005000001001A.en: Filament Track Switch certification failed. Please reconnect the cable or restart the printer.

0700200000020012.en: AMS A slot 1 feeder unit motor is stalled, cannot rotate the spool.
0700200000020012.zh: AMS A 槽 1 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

0700200000020013.en: AMS A slot 1 feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
0700200000020013.zh: AMS A 槽 1 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

0700200000020014.en: AMS A slot 1 filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
0700200000020014.zh: AMS A 槽 1 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

0700200000020015.en: AMS A slot 1 filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
0700200000020015.zh: AMS A 槽 1 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

0700200000020016.en: AMS A slot 1 assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
0700200000020016.zh: AMS A 槽 1 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

0700200000020017.en: AMS A slot 1 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
0700200000020017.zh: AMS A 槽 1 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

0700200000020018.en: AMS A slot 1 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
0700200000020018.zh: AMS A 槽 1 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

0700200000020019.en: AMS A slot 1 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
0700200000020019.zh: AMS A 槽 1 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

0700200000020020.en: AMS A slot 1 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。
0700200000020020.zh: AMS A 槽 1 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

0700200000020021.en: AMS A slot 1 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
0700200000020021.zh: AMS A 槽 1 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

0700200000020022.en: AMS A slot 1 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
0700200000020022.zh: AMS A 槽 1 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

0700200000020023.en: AMS A slot 1 the tube inside the AMS is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
0700200000020023.zh: AMS A 槽 1 AMS内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

0700200000020024.en: AMS A slot 1 failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
0700200000020024.zh: AMS A 槽 1 耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

0700200000020025.en: AMS A slot 1 feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
0700200000020025.zh: AMS A 槽 1 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

0700200000020057.en: The RFID-tag on AMS A Slot 1 cannot be identified.
0700200000020057.zh: 无法识别 AMS A 料卷 1 的标签内容。

0700200000030001.en: AMS A Slot 1 filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
0700200000030001.zh: AMS A 槽位1耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

0700200000030002.en: AMS A Slot 1 filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
0700200000030002.zh: AMS A 槽位1耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

0700210000010081.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS A slot 2. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning.
0700210000010081.zh: 读取AMS A槽位2的耗材信息失败，可能是AMS主板故障。

0700210000010082.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS A slot 2. A non-official RFID tag was detected. You can try to use Bambu Lab filament.
0700210000010082.zh: 读取AMS A槽位2的耗材信息失败，非官方标签，建议使用官方耗材。

0700210000010083.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS A slot 2. The RFID tag may be damaged.
0700210000010083.zh: 读取AMS A槽位2的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏。

0700210000010084.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS A slot 2. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
0700210000010084.zh: 读取AMS A槽位2的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏或处于RFID检测装置边缘，请减掉5厘米耗材后重试。

0700210000010085.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS A slot 2. RFID tag verification failed. You can try to use Bambu Lab filament.

0700210000020004.zh: AMS A 槽位2耗材可能断在工具头。

0700230000020006.zh: AMS A 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。

070023000002000A.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS A 槽 4 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

0700230000020010.en: AMS A slot 4 feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
0700230000020010.zh: AMS A 槽 4 耗材送出AMS超时。

0700230000020011.zh: AMS A 槽 4 耗材退回AMS超时。

0700230000020012.zh: AMS A 槽 4 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

0700230000020013.en: AMS A slot 4 feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
0700230000020013.zh: AMS A 槽 4 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

0700230000020014.zh: AMS A 槽 4 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

0700230000020015.en: AMS A slot 4 filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
0700230000020015.zh: AMS A 槽 4 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

0700230000020016.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
0700230000020016.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

0700230000020017.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
0700230000020017.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

0700230000020018.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
0700230000020018.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

0700230000020019.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
0700230000020019.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

0700230000020020.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。
0700230000020020.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

0700230000020021.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
0700230000020021.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

0700230000020022.en: AMS A slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
0700230000020022.zh: AMS A 槽 4 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

0700230000020023.en: AMS A slot 4 the tube inside the AMS is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.

0700230000020024.en: AMS A slot 4 failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
0700230000020024.zh: AMS A 槽 4 耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

0700230000020025.en: AMS A slot 4 feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
0700230000020025.zh: AMS A 槽 4 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

0700230000020057.zh: 无法识别 AMS A 料卷 4 的标签内容。

0700320000020002.zh: AMS A槽位3 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

0700330000020002.en: The RFID-tag on AMS A Slot4 is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
0700330000020002.zh: AMS A槽位4 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

0700350000010002.zh: AMS A湿度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

0700400000020001.en: AMS A Filament buffer position signal lost: the cable or position sensor may be malfunctioning.
0700400000020001.zh: AMS A 缓冲器位置信号丢失，可能连接线异常或位置传感器异常。

0700400000020002.en: Filament buffer position signal error: the position sensor may be malfunctioning.
0700400000020002.zh: 缓冲区位置信号异常，可能位置传感器异常。

0700400000020003.zh: 多通缓冲通信异常，可能连接线异常。

0700400000020004.zh: 缓冲区位置信号异常，可能缓冲区弹簧卡住或耗材缠绕。

0700400000020005.zh: 缠料检测霍尔传感器已损坏，请参考Wiki更换。

0700400000020006.zh: 缠料检测霍尔传感器短路，请参考Wiki更换。

0700450000020001.zh: 切料传感器异常。请检查连接器是否正确插入。

0700450000020002.zh: 切刀刀柄行程异常，可能电机丢步或XY未回零。

0700500000020002.zh: 检测到当前打印使用的 AMS 已断开连接，请检查连接。恢复连接后打印将自动继续。

0700550000010003.zh: AMS初始化过程中检测到AMS A离线。

0700550000010004.zh: AMS A与挤出机的绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

0700560000030001.zh: AMS A正在进行烘干冷却，请等待其降温后操作。

0700600000020001.zh: AMS A 槽位1 过载。可能耗材缠绕或缓冲器卡住。

0700700000020001.en: Failed to pull out the AMS A Slot 1 filament from the extruder. Possible cause: clogged extruder or broken filament inside the extruder. / Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. Possible causes: clogged extruder or broken filament.
0700700000020001.zh: AMS A槽1的耗材退出挤出机失败，可能是堵头或者耗材断在挤出机内部。 / 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能是堵头或者耗材断在挤出机内部。

0700700000020002.zh: AMS A槽1的耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。 / 耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

0702230000010086.zh: 读取AMS C槽位4的耗材信息失败，可能是进退料过程卡住导致RFID标签无法转动，请拔出耗材重试。

0702230000020002.zh: AMS C 槽位4为空，请插入耗材。

0702230000020006.zh: AMS C 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。

0702230000020007.zh: AMS C 槽位4出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

0702230000020008.zh: AMS C 槽位4进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

0702230000020009.en: Failed to extrude AMS C Slot 4 filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.

070223000002000A.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS C 槽 4 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

0702230000020011.zh: AMS C 槽 4 耗材退回AMS超时。

0702230000020012.zh: AMS C 槽 4 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

0702230000020013.en: AMS C slot 4 feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
0702230000020013.zh: AMS C 槽 4 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

0702230000020014.en: AMS C slot 4 filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
0702230000020014.zh: AMS C 槽 4 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

0702230000020015.zh: AMS C 槽 4 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

0702230000020016.zh: AMS C 槽 4 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

0702230000020017.en: AMS C slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
0702230000020017.zh: AMS C 槽 4 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

0702230000020018.en: AMS C slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
0702230000020018.zh: AMS C 槽 4 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

0702230000020020.zh: AMS C 槽 4 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

0702230000020022.en: AMS C slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
0702230000020022.zh: AMS C 槽 4 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

0702230000020024.zh: AMS C 槽 4 耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

0702230000020057.zh: 无法识别 AMS C 料卷 4 的标签内容。

0704200000020012.en: AMS E slot 1 feeder unit motor is stalled, cannot rotate the spool.
0704200000020012.zh: AMS E 槽 1 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

0704200000020013.en: AMS E slot 1 feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
0704200000020013.zh: AMS E 槽 1 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

0704200000020014.en: AMS E slot 1 filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
0704200000020014.zh: AMS E 槽 1 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

0704200000020015.en: AMS E slot 1 filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
0704200000020015.zh: AMS E 槽 1 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

0704200000020016.en: AMS E slot 1 assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
0704200000020016.zh: AMS E 槽 1 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

0704200000020017.en: AMS E slot 1 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
0704200000020017.zh: AMS E 槽 1 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

0704200000020018.en: AMS E slot 1 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
0704200000020018.zh: AMS E 槽 1 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

0704200000020019.en: AMS E slot 1 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
0704200000020019.zh: AMS E 槽 1 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

0704200000020020.en: AMS E slot 1 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。
0704200000020020.zh: AMS E 槽 1 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

0704200000020021.en: AMS E slot 1 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
0704200000020021.zh: AMS E 槽 1 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

0704200000020022.en: AMS E slot 1 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
0704200000020022.zh: AMS E 槽 1 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

0704200000020023.en: AMS E slot 1 the tube inside the AMS is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
0704200000020023.zh: AMS E 槽 1 AMS内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

0704200000020024.en: AMS E slot 1 failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
0704200000020024.zh: AMS E 槽 1 耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

0704200000020025.en: AMS E slot 1 feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
0704200000020025.zh: AMS E 槽 1 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

0704200000030001.en: AMS E Slot 1 filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
0704200000030001.zh: AMS E 槽位1耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

0704200000030002.en: AMS E Slot 1 filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
0704200000030002.zh: AMS E 槽位1耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

0704210000010081.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS E slot 2. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning.
0704210000010081.zh: 读取AMS E槽位2的耗材信息失败，可能是AMS主板故障。

0704210000010082.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS E slot 2. A non-official RFID tag was detected. You can try to use Bambu Lab filament.
0704210000010082.zh: 读取AMS E槽位2的耗材信息失败，非官方标签，建议使用官方耗材。

0704210000010083.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS E slot 2. The RFID tag may be damaged.
0704210000010083.zh: 读取AMS E槽位2的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏。

0704210000010084.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS E slot 2. The RFID tag may be damaged or positioned at the edge of the RFID detection device. Please remove 5cm filament and try again.
0704210000010084.zh: 读取AMS E槽位2的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏或处于RFID检测装置边缘，请减掉5厘米耗材后重试。

0704230000020020.en: AMS E slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。
0704230000020020.zh: AMS E 槽 4 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

0704230000020021.zh: AMS E 槽 4 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。
