0C00010000010010.en: The Live View Camera calibration failed. Please check if the heatbed is clear and ensure the camera image is clear and dirt-free. After these steps, please recalibrate.
0C00010000010010.zh: 实况摄像头校准失败。请留意热床是否被清空，摄像头图像清晰无脏污，处理后请重新校准。

0C00010000010011.en: The Live View Camera calibration failed, please recalibrate. Ensure the build plate is empty, and the camera view is clear and properly oriented. Please contact customer support if repeated failures occur.
0C00010000010011.zh: 实况摄像头校准失败，请重新标定。标定前请确保：垫板清空、摄像头画面清晰且图像正立。若多次校准失败，请联系售后。

0C00010000010012.en: The Live View Camera calibration failed and the calibration result could not be saved. Please try recalibrating. If calibration fails repeatedly, please contact the customer support team.
0C00010000010012.zh: 实况摄像头校准失败，校准结果无法写入，请尝试重新校准。若多次校准失败，请联系售后。

0C00010000010013.en: The Live View Camera calibration failed and the Liveview camera serial number cannot be read. Please contact the customer support team.
0C00010000010013.zh: 实况摄像头校准失败，无法读取实况摄像头序列号，请联系售后。

0C00010000020002.en: Micro Lidar camera is malfunctioning. Please refer to the Wiki for troubleshooting. / Toolhead camera is malfunctioning. If this issue occurs multiple times during printing, please contact customer support.
0C00010000020002.zh: 工具头摄像头异常。若多次打印都出现该消息，请联系售后。 / 微型激光雷达相机发生故障，请参考Wiki进行故障排查。

0C00010000020007.en: Micro Lidar laser parameters have drifted. Please re-calibrate your printer.
0C00010000020007.zh: 激光器参数发生飘移，请重新校准机器。

0C00010000020008.en: Failed to get image from Live View Camera. Spaghetti and waste chute pileup detection is not available at this time.
0C00010000020008.zh: 获取实况摄像头的图像失败，炒面及堆料检测暂时失效。

0C00010000020014.en: Nozzle Camera is malfunctioning. If this issue occurs multiple times during printing, please contact customer support.
0C00010000020014.zh: 喷嘴摄像头异常，若多次打印出现此消息，请联系售后。

0C00010000020017.en: Nozzle camera lens is dirty, which may affect the AI monitoring functionality. Please clean the surface of the nozzle camera lens as soon as possible.
0C00010000020017.zh: 喷嘴摄像头镜头脏污，对AI监控功能有影响，请尽快清理镜头。

0C0001000003000C.en: Nozzle Camera's temperature is too high, causing the AI detection feature to pause. The feature will automatically resume once the temperature returns to normal.
0C0001000003000C.zh: 喷嘴摄像头温度过高导致AI检测功能暂停。当摄像头温度降到正常范围后，功能自动恢复。

0C00020000010001.en: The horizontal laser is not lit. Please check if it's covered or hardware connection has a problem. / The laser height probe is not lit. Please check if it is blocked or if the connection cable is disconnected.
0C00020000010001.zh: 水平激光器不亮，请检查激光器是否被遮挡，或线路是否正常。 / 激光测高器不亮，请检查激光器是否被遮挡或激光器连接线断开。

0C00020000010005.en: A new Micro Lidar was detected. Please calibrate it on the Calibration page before use.
0C00020000010005.zh: 发现新的激光雷达，使用前请点击机器校准完成校准。

0C00020000020002.en: The horizontal laser line is too wide. Please check if the heatbed is dirty.
0C00020000020002.zh: 水平激光线过宽，请检查打印板上是否脏污。

0C00020000020003.en: The horizontal laser is not bright enough at homing position. Please clean or replace the heatbed if this message appears repeatedly.
0C00020000020003.zh: 检测到水平激光器在回中位置的亮度偏低，若该提示频繁出现，请清洗或更换打印板。

0C00020000020004.en: Nozzle height seems to be too low. Please check if the nozzle is worn or tilted. Re-calibrate Lidar if the nozzle has been replaced.
0C00020000020004.zh: 检测到喷嘴高度过低。请检查喷嘴是否有明显的磨损或倾斜。如更换过喷嘴请重新校准激光雷达。

0C00020000020006.en: Nozzle height seems to be too high. Please check if there is residual filament attached to the nozzle.
0C00020000020006.zh: 检测到喷嘴高度过高。请检查喷嘴处是否有残料附着。

0C00020000020007.en: The vertical laser is not lit. Please check if it's covered or hardware connection has a problem.
0C00020000020007.zh: 竖直激光器不亮，请检查激光器是否被遮挡，或线路是否正常。

0C00020000020008.en: The vertical laser line is too wide. Please check if the heatbed is dirty.
0C00020000020008.zh: 竖直激光线过宽，请检查打印板上是否脏污。

0C00020000020009.en: The vertical laser is not bright enough at homing position. Please clean or replace the heatbed if this message appears repeatedly.
0C00020000020009.zh: 竖直激光器在回中位置的亮度偏低，若该提示频繁出现，请清洗或更换打印板。

0C00030000010009.en: The first layer inspection module rebooted abnormally. The inspection result may be inaccurate.
0C00030000010009.zh: 首层质量检查模块异常重启，本次检查结果可能不准确。

0C0003000001000A.en: Your printer is in factory mode. Please contact Technical Support.
0C0003000001000A.zh: 打印机处于工厂态，请联系售后。

0C0003000001001E.en: Smoke detected. Power off the device immediately. Refer to the Wiki to inspect the hotend heating module for damage.
0C0003000001001E.zh: 检测到烟雾，请立即断开设备电源，并参考 Wiki 检查热端加热模块是否损坏。

0C00030000020001.en: Filament exposure metering failed because laser reflection is too weak on this material. First layer inspection may be inaccurate.
0C00030000020001.zh: 由于该材料的反光太弱，耗材自动测光失败，本次首层质量检查可能不准确。

0C00030000020002.en: First layer inspection terminated due to abnormal Lidar data.
0C00030000020002.zh: 激光雷达数据异常，本次首层质量检查无法进行。

0C00030000020004.en: First layer inspection is not supported for the current print job.
0C00030000020004.zh: 本次打印不支持首层质量检查。

0C00030000020005.en: First layer inspection timed out abnormally, and the current results may be inaccurate.
0C00030000020005.zh: 激光雷达扫描异常超时, 当前扫描结果可能不准确。

0C0003000002000C.en: The build plate localization marker was not detected. Please check if the build plate is aligned correctly.
0C0003000002000C.zh: 没有检测到打印板定位标记。请检查打印板是否正确放置。

0C0003000002000E.en: Your nozzle seems to be covered with jammed or clogged material.
0C0003000002000E.zh: 检测到可能发生了裹头。

0C0003000002000F.en: Parts skipped before first layer inspection; the inspection is not supported for the current print.
0C0003000002000F.zh: 因首层检查前跳过了零件，当前打印将不支持首层检查。

0C00030000020010.en: Foreign objects detected on heatbed; Please check and clean the heatbed.
0C00030000020010.zh: 检测到热床上异物，请检查并清理。

0C00030000020011.en: The high-precision nozzle offset calibration failed; please recalibrate.
0C00030000020011.zh: 高精度喷嘴偏移校准失败，请重新校准。

0C00030000020012.en: Foreign object detection is not working. The Live View Camera needs calibration. Please tap 'Settings > Calibration' on the printer screen. / Foreign object detection is not working. The Live View Camera needs calibration. Please tap 'Settings > Calibration' on the printer screen. If a laser or cutting module is installed, please remove it before calibration.
0C00030000020012.zh: 异物检测未生效，实况摄像头需要校准，请在打印机屏幕点击“设置>校准”。 / 异物检测未生效，实况摄像头需要校准，请在打印机屏幕点击“设置>校准”。如有安装激光或刀切模组，请先取下后再试。

0C00030000020013.en: Foreign object detection is not working. Please restart the devices or update the firmware.
0C00030000020013.zh: 异物检测未生效，请重启设备或更新固件。

0C00030000020014.en: Foreign object detection accuracy has decreased. If this occurs frequently, perform a Live View Camera calibration (“Settings” > “Calibration” on the printer screen). / Foreign object detection accuracy has decreased. If this occurs frequently, perform a Live View Camera calibration (“Settings” > “Calibration” on the printer screen). If a laser or cutting module is installed, remove it before proceeding.
0C00030000020014.zh: 异物检测精度下降。若频繁出现，建议进行实况摄像头校准（点击屏幕 “设置” > “校准”）。 / 异物检测精度下降。若频繁出现，建议进行实况摄像头校准（点击屏幕 “设置” > “校准”）。如有安装激光或刀切模组，请先取下后再操作。

0C00030000020015.en: Foreign object detection is not working. Detected the Live View Camera has been replaced. If a laser or cutting module is installed, please uninstall the module, tap 'Settings>Calibration' on printer screen and re-calibrate the Live View Camera. / Foreign object detection is not working. Detected the Live View Camera has been replaced. Please tap 'Settings>Calibration' on printer screen and re-calibrate the Live View Camera.
0C00030000020015.zh: 异物检测未生效，检测到实况摄像头已经更换，如有安装激光或刀切模组，请取下后，在打印机屏幕上点击“设置>校准”，进行实况摄像头校准。 / 异物检测未生效，检测到实况摄像头已经更换，请在打印机屏幕上点击“设置>校准”，进行实况摄像头校准。

0C00030000020016.en: Foreign object detection is not working and the Live View camera serial number cannot be read. Please contact the customer support team.
0C00030000020016.zh: 异物检测未生效，无法读取实况摄像头序列号，请联系售后。

0C00030000020017.en: Laser engraving Z-axis focus calibration failed. Please check if the Laser Test Material (350g paperboard) is properly placed and its surface is clean and intact.
0C00030000020017.zh: 雕刻激光校准Z轴对焦失败，请检查激光测试材料（350g卡纸）是否正确放置且表面干净完好。

0C00030000020018.en: Insufficient system memory was detected, and the foreign object detection function was not working. Please restart the devices or update the firmware after the task is completed
0C00030000020018.zh: 检测到系统内存不足，异物检测功能未生效。可在任务结束后重启打印机或升级最新固件以改善该问题。

0C00030000020019.en: The Vision Encoder Plate is either not placed or incorrectly placed. Please ensure it is correctly positioned on the heatbed.
0C00030000020019.zh: 视觉编码器板未放置或放置不当，请确认已经在热床上正确放置。

0C0003000002001C.en: Your nozzle seems to be covered with jammed or clogged material.
0C0003000002001C.zh: 检测到可能发生了裹头。

0C0003000002001D.en: Foreign object detection is not working, and images cannot be obtained. Please check the live camera connection.
0C0003000002001D.zh: 异物检测未生效，无法获取图像，请检查实况摄像头连接状态。

0C00030000030006.en: Purged filament may have piled up in the waste chute. Please check and clean the chute.
0C00030000030006.zh: 可能发生废料堆积。请检查并清理废料槽。

0C00030000030007.en: Possible first layer defects have been detected. Please check the first layer quality and decide if the job should be stopped.
0C00030000030007.zh: 可能发生首层打印缺陷。请检查首层质量并决定是否停止任务。

0C00030000030008.en: A possible spaghetti failure has been detected. Please check the print quality and decide whether to stop the job. Cleaning the build plate or drying the filament can effectively reduce the risk of spaghetti failure.
0C00030000030008.zh: 可能发生炒面缺陷，请检查打印质量并决定是否停止任务。清洗打印板、烘干耗材，可以有效降低炒面风险。

0C0003000003000B.en: Inspecting the first layer: please wait a moment.

0C0003000003000D.en: Detected that the extruder may not be extruding normally. Please check and decide if printing should be stopped.
0C0003000003000D.zh: 检测到喷嘴可能没有正常挤出。请检查并确认是否需要停止打印。

0C00030000030010.en: Your printer seems to be printing without extruding.
0C00030000030010.zh: 检测到可能发生了空打。

0C0003000003001B.en: Possible spaghetti defects were detected. Please check the print quality and decide if the job should be stopped. Cleaning the build plate or drying the filament can effectively reduce the risk of spaghetti failure.
0C0003000003001B.zh: 可能发生炒面缺陷。请检查打印质量并决定是否停止任务。清洗打印板、烘干耗材，可以有效降低炒面风险。

0C00040000010005.en: BirdsEye Camera malfunction: please contact customer support.
0C00040000010005.zh: 俯视摄像头功能异常，请联系售后服务。

0C00040000010010.en: Failed to measure material thickness due to laser module malfunction.
0C00040000010010.zh: 材料厚度测量失败，激光模组功能异常。

0C00040000010011.en: Failed to measure material thickness: device parameters abnormal; please setup BirdsEye Camera again.
0C00040000010011.zh: 材料厚度测量失败，设备参数异常。请重新运行俯视摄像头初始化。

0C00040000010012.en: Live View Camera data link is abnormal.
0C00040000010012.zh: 实况摄像头数据链路异常。

0C00040000010013.en: The exposure parameters of the BirdsEye Camera are not effective; please try again.
0C00040000010013.zh: 俯视摄像头的曝光参数设置没有生效，请重试。

0C00040000010014.en: Cutting Protection Base not detected, which may lead to heatbed damage. Please place it and continue.
0C00040000010014.zh: 未检测到刀切保护钢板，有损坏热床风险，请放置后继续。

0C00040000010015.en: Laser Protective Insert not detected. Please place it and continue.
0C00040000010015.zh: 未检测到激光保护铝板，请放置后继续。

0C00040000010016.en: Quick-release Lever is not locked. Please push it down to secure.
0C00040000010016.zh: 快拆锁扣未锁定，请向下扣紧。

0C00040000010020.en: The visual marker on the heatbed is damaged, please contact after-sales.
0C00040000010020.zh: 热床视觉标志损坏，请联系售后。

0C00040000020002.en: Cutting Platform not detected. Please place the required mat for the task and continue.
0C00040000020002.zh: 未检测到粘性刀切粘板，请放置任务需要的粘板后继续。

0C00040000020003.en: The Laser Platform is not properly aligned. Please ensure all four corners are aligned with the heatbed.
0C00040000020003.zh: 激光工作底板偏移，请确保底板的四角与热床对齐。

0C00040000020004.en: The type of platform is not supported for this task. Please use the correct platform to continue.
0C00040000020004.zh: 垫板类型不支持该任务，请使用正确的垫板继续任务。

0C00040000020007.en: BirdsEye Camera is setting up. Please clear all objects and remove the mat. Make sure the marker is not obstructed. Meanwhile, clean both the BirdsEye Camera and Toolhead Camera, and remove any foreign objects blocking their view.
0C00040000020007.zh: 俯视摄像头正在初始化，请清空热床上的所有物体并拿开垫板。确保热床标记不被遮挡。同时，请清理俯视摄像头及工具头摄像头，并移除可能遮挡摄像头的异物。

0C00040000020008.en: Material not detected. Please confirm placement and continue.
0C00040000020008.zh: 未检测到制作材料，请确认放置材料后继续。

0C00040000020017.en: The visual marker was not detected during PrintThenCut; please re-paste the material to the correct position. Meanwhile, please clean the Toolhead Camera to prevent contamination and remove any objects that may obstruct its view.
0C00040000020017.zh: 打印后刀切未检测到视觉标志，请重新粘贴材料。可查阅wiki获得详细解决方案。

0C00040000020018.en: The Cutting Blade offset calibration failed. This may affect the cutting accuracy. Please refer to the Assistant to check if the blade tip is worn.
0C00040000020018.zh: 模切刀偏移校准失败，本次切割可能存在误差。请检查切割刀尖是否已磨损。可查阅wiki获得详细解决方案。

0C00040000020019.en: The Birdseye Camera is installed offset. Please refer to the Wiki to reinstall it.
0C00040000020019.zh: 俯视摄像头安装偏移，请参照Wiki重新进行安装

0C00040000020023.en: Thickness measurement failed, the Toolhead Camera was unable to detect the material surface.
0C00040000020023.zh: 测厚失败，工具头摄像头没有识别到材料表面。

0C00040000020026.en: Liveview Camera initialization failed, and some AI functions such as Spaghetti Detection will be disabled. Please restart the printer. If the problem persists, please contact customer support.
0C00040000020026.zh: 实况摄像头初始化失败，炒面检测等部分AI功能会失效。请重启打印机，若仍遇到此问题，请联系售后。

0C00040000020029.en: The Laser or Cutting module has not been calibrated. Please calibrate it on the printer first.
0C00040000020029.zh: 激光或刀切模块未校准，请先在打印机上校准。

0C00040000020030.en: The liveview camera is not functioning properly. Please restart the machine and try again.
0C00040000020030.zh: 实况相机工作异常，请重启机器。

0C00040000020031.en: The liveview camera may be dirty or obstructed. Please check and clean it.
0C00040000020031.zh: 实况相机脏污或被遮挡，请检查并清理。

0C00040000020032.en: The BirdsEye Camera is initializing. Please make sure the markers on the cutting mat are not obstructed, clean both the BirdsEye Camera and the Toolhead Camera, and remove any foreign objects that may block the cameras.
0C00040000020032.zh: 俯视摄像头正在初始化，请确保刀切垫板上的标记未被遮挡，并清洁俯视摄像头和工具头摄像头，移除任何可能遮挡摄像头视野的异物。

0C00040000020033.en: Measurement failed because the object is not properly clamped on the Rotary Attachment, the object diameter is too small, or the claws are positioned above the object. Please place and secure the object correctly on the Rotary Attachment.
0C00040000020033.zh: 旋转轴未正确夹持物体、物体直径过小或夹爪位于物体上方，导致无法测量，请将物体正确放置并夹持在旋转轴上。

0C00040000020034.en: Capture image failed. Please initiate the measurement again.
0C00040000020034.zh: 拍照测量失败，请重新发起测量。

0C00040000020035.en: The rotary attachment is installed, so Measure Thickness and Curved Surface Measurement are unavailable. Please remove the rotary attachment first, then try again.
0C00040000020035.zh: 设备已装载旋转组件，无法使用平面测厚、曲面测量等功能。请先拆卸旋转组件，然后重新尝试。

0C00040000030018.en: The Cutting blade offset calibration failed. This may affect the cutting accuracy. Please refer to the Wiki to check if the blade tip is worn.
0C00040000030018.zh: 模切刀偏移校准失败，本次切割可能存在误差。请检查切割刀尖是否已磨损。可查阅wiki获得详细解决方案。

0C00040000030024.en: The BirdsEye Camera position is detected to be offset. To ensure engraving accuracy, it is recommended to rerun the BirdsEye Camera Setup.
0C00040000030024.zh: 检测到俯视摄像头位置发生偏移，为保证雕刻位置精度，建议重新运行俯视摄像头初始化。

0C00040000030026.en: To improve flame detection accuracy, the right chamber light has been automatically turned off.
0C00040000030026.zh: 为提高火焰检测精度，设备已自动关闭右侧腔体照明灯。

0C00040000030028.en: The Cutting Module offset calibration failed, which may result in inaccurate cuts. Please ensure the 80g white printer paper (letter paper thickness) is properly positioned; if the blade tip is worn, replace it. If the issue persists after checking, restart the device and try again.
0C00040000030028.zh: 刀切模组偏移校准失败，切割可能存在误差。请先确认已正确放置 80g 打印纸（相当于 A4 纸厚度）；如切割刀尖已磨损，请更换。若检查正常后问题仍存在，请重启设备后再次尝试。

1200100000010001.en: The AMS Lite A Slot1 motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
1200100000010001.zh: AMS Lite A 有刷电机1打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

1200100000010003.en: The AMS Lite A Slot1 motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
1200100000010003.zh: AMS Lite A 有刷电机1扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

1200100000020002.en: The AMS Lite A Slot1 motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.
1200100000020002.zh: AMS Lite A 有刷电机1过载，可能供料路径阻力大或耗材缠绕。

1200110000010001.en: The AMS Lite A Slot2 motor has slipped. The extrusion wheel may be malfunctioning, or the filament may be too thin.
1200110000010001.zh: AMS Lite A 有刷电机2打滑，可能挤出轮磨损或耗材过细。

1200110000010003.en: The AMS Lite A Slot2 motor torque control is malfunctioning. The current sensor may be faulty.
1200110000010003.zh: AMS Lite A 有刷电机2扭矩控制异常，可能是电流传感器异常。

1200110000020002.en: The AMS Lite A Slot2 motor is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or stuck.

1800220000020007.zh: AMS-HT A 槽位3出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

1800220000020008.en: AMS-HT A Slot 3 feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
1800220000020008.zh: AMS-HT A 槽位3进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

1800220000020009.en: Failed to extrude AMS-HT A Slot 3 filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.
1800220000020009.zh: AMS-HT A槽位3耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

180022000002000A.en: Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS-HT A Slot 3 filament or the buffer itself may be jammed.
180022000002000A.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS-HT A 槽 3 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

1800220000020010.en: AMS-HT A slot 3 feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
1800220000020010.zh: AMS-HT A 槽 3 耗材送出AMS超时。

1800220000020011.zh: AMS-HT A 槽 3 耗材退回AMS超时。

1800220000020012.zh: AMS-HT A 槽 3 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

1800220000020013.en: AMS-HT A slot 3 feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
1800220000020013.zh: AMS-HT A 槽 3 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

1800220000020015.en: AMS-HT A slot 3 filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
1800220000020015.zh: AMS-HT A 槽 3 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

1800220000020024.zh: AMS-HT A 槽 3 耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

1800400000020002.zh: 缓冲区位置信号异常，可能位置传感器异常。

1800400000020003.zh: 多通缓冲通信异常，可能连接线异常。

1801230000010084.zh: 读取AMS-HT B槽位4的耗材信息失败，可能是RFID标签损坏或处于RFID检测装置边缘，请减掉5厘米耗材后重试。

1801230000010085.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT B slot 4. RFID tag verification failed. You can try to use Bambu Lab filament.
1801230000010085.zh: 读取AMS-HT B槽位4的耗材信息失败，RFID标签验证失败，建议使用官方耗材。

1801230000010086.en: Failed to read the filament information from AMS-HT B slot 4. The RFID tag cannot rotate due to a jam during the filament loading or unloading. Please pull out the filament and try again.
1801230000010086.zh: 读取AMS-HT B槽位4的耗材信息失败，可能是进退料过程卡住导致RFID标签无法转动，请拔出耗材重试。

1801230000020001.en: AMS-HT B Slot 4 filament has run out. Please insert a new filament.
1801230000020001.zh: AMS-HT B 槽位4耗材用完，请插入新耗材。

1801230000020002.en: AMS-HT B Slot 4 is empty; please insert a new filament.
1801230000020002.zh: AMS-HT B 槽位4为空，请插入耗材。

1801230000020003.en: AMS-HT B Slot 4's filament may be broken in AMS-HT.
1801230000020003.zh: AMS-HT B 槽位4耗材可能断在AMS-HT中。

1801230000020004.en: AMS-HT B Slot 4 filament may be broken in the tool head.
1801230000020004.zh: AMS-HT B 槽位4耗材可能断在工具头。

1801230000020005.en: AMS-HT B Slot 4 filament has run out, and purging the old filament went abnormally; please check whether the filament is stuck in the tool head.
1801230000020005.zh: AMS-HT B 槽位4耗材用完，冲刷旧料异常，请检查耗材是否卡在工具头。

1801230000020006.en: AMS-HT B has detected a breakage of the PTFE tube during filament loading. Please check whether the PTFE tubes inside and outside the AMS have fallen off or been damaged.
1801230000020006.zh: AMS-HT B 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。

1801230000020007.en: AMS-HT B Slot 4 feed-out Hall sensor is disconnected. The connector may have poor contact.
1801230000020007.zh: AMS-HT B 槽位4出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

1801230000020008.en: AMS-HT B Slot 4 feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
1801230000020008.zh: AMS-HT B 槽位4进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

1801230000020009.en: Failed to extrude AMS-HT B Slot 4 filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.
1801230000020009.zh: AMS-HT B槽位4耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

180123000002000A.en: Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS-HT B Slot 4 filament or the buffer itself may be jammed.
180123000002000A.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS-HT B 槽 4 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

1801230000020010.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
1801230000020010.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 耗材送出AMS超时。

1801230000020011.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 pulls filament back to AMS timeout.
1801230000020011.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 耗材退回AMS超时。

1801230000020012.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 feeder unit motor is stalled, cannot rotate the spool.
1801230000020012.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

1801230000020013.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.
1801230000020013.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。

1801230000020014.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault.
1801230000020014.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。

1801230000020015.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
1801230000020015.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

1801230000020016.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again.
1801230000020016.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

1801230000020017.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer.
1801230000020017.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

1801230000020018.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
1801230000020018.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

1801230000020019.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer.
1801230000020019.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。

1801230000020020.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。
1801230000020020.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

1801230000020021.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead.
1801230000020021.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。

1801230000020022.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead.
1801230000020022.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。

1801230000020023.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 the tube inside the AMS is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament.
1801230000020023.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 AMS内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。

1801230000020024.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS.
1801230000020024.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。

1801230000020025.en: AMS-HT B slot 4 feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes.
1801230000020025.zh: AMS-HT B 槽 4 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。

1801230000030001.en: AMS-HT B Slot 4 filament has run out. Please wait while old filament is purged.
1801230000030001.zh: AMS-HT B 槽位4耗材用完，冲刷旧料中，请等待。

1801230000030002.en: AMS-HT B Slot 4 filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament.
1801230000030002.zh: AMS-HT B 槽位4耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。

1801240000010007.en: AMS-HT B door detection is abnormal, the Hall sensor connection may be loose or disconnected.
1801240000010007.zh: AMS-HT B 开门检测异常，可能霍尔传感器连接线松动或脱落。

1801240000020009.en: AMS-HT B front cover is open. This may affect the drying performance or cause the filament to absorb moisture.
1801240000020009.zh: AMS-HT B 前盖打开，可能影响烘干效果或使耗材受潮。

1801250000020001.en: AMS-HT B uses printer power for drying during loading/printing. For better drying performance, please connect a power adapter.
1801250000020001.zh: 检测到 AMS-HT B 在打印/进料过程中使用打印机供电烘干，建议接入电源适配器以获得最佳烘干效果。

1801300000010001.en: The AMS-HT B RFID 1 board has an error.
1801300000010001.zh: AMS-HT B RFID硬件1错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

1801300000020002.en: The RFID-tag on AMS-HT B Slot1 is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
1801300000020002.zh: AMS-HT B槽位1 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

1801300000030003.en: RFID cannot be read because of a hardware or structural error.
1801300000030003.zh: 由于电机或结构问题导致无法识别。

1801310000010001.en: The AMS-HT B RFID 2 board has an error.
1801310000010001.zh: AMS-HT B RFID硬件2错误，可能是RFID射频板线断连或者RFID射频板损坏。

1801310000020002.en: The RFID-tag on AMS-HT B Slot2 is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.

1801320000020002.en: The RFID-tag on AMS-HT B Slot3 is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
1801320000020002.zh: AMS-HT B槽位3 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

1801330000020002.en: The RFID-tag on AMS-HT B Slot4 is damaged, or its content cannot be identified.
1801330000020002.zh: AMS-HT B槽位4 的RFID标签损坏或者标签内容不能被识别。

1801350000010001.zh: 温湿度传感器错误，可能是芯片故障。

1801350000010002.en: AMS-HT B The humidity sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
1801350000010002.zh: AMS-HT B湿度传感器离线,可能是插头接触不良。

1801400000020001.en: AMS-HT B Filament buffer position signal lost: the cable or position sensor may be malfunctioning.
1801400000020001.zh: AMS-HT B 缓冲器位置信号丢失，可能连接线异常或位置传感器异常。

1801500000020002.zh: 检测到当前打印使用的 AMS 已断开连接，请检查连接。恢复连接后打印将自动继续。

1801550000010004.zh: AMS-HT B与挤出机的绑定关系出错，请重新进行AMS初始化。

1801560000030001.zh: AMS-HT B正在进行烘干冷却，请等待其降温后操作。

1801600000020001.en: The AMS-HT B Slot 1 is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or the filament buffer may be stuck.
1801600000020001.zh: AMS-HT B 槽位1 过载。可能耗材缠绕或缓冲器卡住。

1801610000020001.en: The AMS-HT B Slot 2 is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or the filament buffer may be stuck.
1801610000020001.zh: AMS-HT B 槽位2 过载。可能耗材缠绕或缓冲器卡住。

1801620000020001.en: The AMS-HT B Slot 3 is overloaded. The filament may be tangled or the filament buffer may be stuck.

1801700000020001.zh: AMS-HT B槽1的耗材退出挤出机失败，可能是堵头或者耗材断在挤出机内部。 / 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能是堵头或者耗材断在挤出机内部。

1801700000020002.zh: AMS-HT B槽1的耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。 / 耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是耗材或料盘卡住。

1804210000020001.en: AMS-HT E Slot 2 filament has run out. Please insert a new filament.
1804210000020001.zh: AMS-HT E 槽位2耗材用完，请插入新耗材。

1804210000020003.en: AMS-HT E Slot 2's filament may be broken in AMS-HT.

1804210000020006.en: AMS-HT E has detected a breakage of the PTFE tube during filament loading. Please check whether the PTFE tubes inside and outside the AMS have fallen off or been damaged.

1804210000020007.en: AMS-HT E Slot 2 feed-out Hall sensor is disconnected. The connector may have poor contact.
1804210000020007.zh: AMS-HT E 槽位2出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。

1804210000020008.en: AMS-HT E Slot 2 feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact.
1804210000020008.zh: AMS-HT E 槽位2进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

1804210000020009.en: Failed to extrude AMS-HT E Slot 2 filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip.
1804210000020009.zh: AMS-HT E槽位2耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。

180421000002000A.en: Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS-HT E Slot 2 filament or the buffer itself may be jammed.
180421000002000A.zh: 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS-HT E 槽 2 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。

1804210000020010.en: AMS-HT E slot 2 feeds filament out of AMS timeout.
1804210000020010.zh: AMS-HT E 槽 2 耗材送出AMS超时。

1804210000020011.zh: AMS-HT E 槽 2 耗材退回AMS超时。

1804210000020012.zh: AMS-HT E 槽 2 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。

1804210000020013.en: AMS-HT E slot 2 feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault.

1804210000020016.zh: AMS-HT E 槽 2 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。

1804210000020017.zh: AMS-HT E 槽 2 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。

1804210000020018.en: AMS-HT E slot 2 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS.
1804210000020018.zh: AMS-HT E 槽 2 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。

1804210000020020.en: AMS-HT E slot 2 assist motor is stalled，due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer。

1806230000020002.zh: AMS-HT G 槽位4为空，请插入耗材。

1806230000020008.zh: AMS-HT G 槽位4进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。

1806230000020011.zh: AMS-HT G 槽 4 耗材退回AMS超时。

1806230000020015.en: AMS-HT G slot 4 filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS.
1806230000020015.zh: AMS-HT G 槽 4 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。

1806230000020020.zh: AMS-HT G 槽 4 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。

18FE810000010006.zh: 挤出机切换过程中TH板断联，请检查连接排线是否松动。

18FE810000020001.en: The extruder switching action is abnormal. Please check whether there is something stuck in the toolhead.
18FE810000020001.zh: 挤出切换动作异常，请检查是否有异物卡在工具头内。

18FF200000020001.en: External filament has run out; please load a new filament. / External filament of right extruder has run out; please load a new filament.
18FF200000020001.zh: 右挤出机外部挂载的耗材用完；请装入新的耗材。 / 外部挂载的耗材用完；请装入新的耗材。

18FF200000020002.en: External filament is missing; please load a new filament. / No filament was detected in the right extruder from the external spool; please load the new filament.
18FF200000020002.zh: 未发现右挤出机外部挂载的耗材；请装入新的耗材。 / 未发现外部挂载的耗材；请装入新的耗材。

18FF200000020004.en: Please pull the external filament from the extruder. / Please pull the external filament from the right extruder.
18FF200000020004.zh: 请从右挤出机中拉出外部挂载的耗材。 / 请从挤出机中拉出外部挂载的耗材。

18FF450000020002.en: The filament cutter's cutting distance is too large. Possible causes include the filament cutter stopper skipping teeth, motor losing steps, or the XY axis not being homed.
18FF450000020002.zh: 切刀刀柄行程异常，可能切刀触发杆跳齿、电机丢步或XY未回零。

18FF450000020003.en: The filament cutter handle has not been released. The handle or blade may be jammed, or there could be an issue with the filament sensor connection.
18FF450000020003.zh: 切刀刀柄未松开，刀柄或刀片可能被卡住，或耗材霍尔接线异常。

18FF600000020001.en: External spool connected to right extruder may be tangled or jammed. / External spool may be tangled or jammed.
18FF600000020001.zh: 右挤出机外部挂载的耗材缠绕或料盘卡住。 / 挤出机外部挂载的耗材缠绕或料盘卡住。

18FF700000020003.en: Please check if the material is coming out of the right nozzle. If not, gently push the material and try to extrude again.
18FF700000020003.zh: 请检查耗材是否从右喷嘴挤出。如未挤出，请轻推耗材后重试

18FF700000020008.en: Failed to get AMS mapping table; please select 'Resume' to retry.
18FF700000020008.zh: 多次获取AMS映射表失败，请点击“继续”重试。

18FF800000010001.en: The toolhead lift motor works abnormally. Please check whether the connecting cable is loose.
18FF800000010001.zh: 工具头升降电机工作异常，请检查连接排线是否松动。

18FF800000010002.en: The Toolhead Lifting Motor position hall sensor has an open circuit; please check whether the connecting cable is loose.
18FF800000010002.zh: 工具头升降电机位置霍尔传感器断路，请检查连接排线是否松动。

18FF800000010003.en: The hall signal of the Toolhead Lifting Motor is abnormal, possibly due to internal communication failure in the Toolhead module.
18FF800000010003.zh: 工具头升降电机位置霍尔信号异常，可能是工具头内部通信故障。

18FF800000010004.en: The Toolhead Lifting Motor position hall sensor is short-circuited; please check if the Hall sensor is malfunctioning.
18FF800000010004.zh: 工具头升降电机位置霍尔传感器短路，请检查霍尔传感器是否异常。

18FF800000010006.en: The TH board disconnected during the extruder switching process. Please check if the connecting cable is loose.
18FF800000010006.zh: 挤出机切换过程中TH板断联，请检查连接排线是否松动。

18FF800000020001.en: The lifting action is abnormal during the extruder switch. Please check whether the flow blocker is stuck or there is filament stuck in the toolhead.
18FF800000020001.zh: 挤出机切换过程中升降动作异常，请检查堵嘴片是否卡住或是否有耗材卡在工具头内。

18FF800000020002.en: The position of left hotend is abnormal during printing. Please check whether the flow blocker scratches the printed model.
18FF800000020002.zh: 打印过程中左热端位置异常，请检查堵嘴片是否剐蹭打印模型。

18FF800000020003.en: The deviation in the positioning calibration value of the extruder is too large; please recalibrate.
18FF800000020003.zh: 挤出机位置校准数值偏差过大，请重新校准。

18FF810000010001.en: The extruder switching motor is working abnormally. Please check whether the connecting cable is loose.
18FF810000010001.zh: 挤出切换电机工作异常，请检查连接排线是否松动。

18FF810000010002.en: The position hall sensor of the Extruder Switching Motor has an open circuit. Please check whether the connecting cable is loose.
18FF810000010002.zh: 挤出切换电机位置霍尔传感器断路，请检查连接排线是否松动。

18FF810000010003.en: The hall signal of the Extruder Switching Motor is abnormal, possibly due to internal communication failure in the Toolhead module.
18FF810000010003.zh: 挤出切换电机位置霍尔信号异常，可能工具头模块内部通信故障。

18FF810000010004.en: The position hall sensor of the Extruder Switching Motor has a short circuit; please check if the Hall sensor is malfunctioning.
18FF810000010004.zh: 挤出切换电机位置霍尔传感器短路，请检查霍尔传感器是否异常。

18FF810000010006.en: The TH board disconnected during the extruder switching process. Please check if the connecting cable is loose.
18FF810000010006.zh: 挤出机切换过程中TH板断联，请检查连接排线是否松动。

18FF810000020001.en: The extruder switching action is abnormal. Please check whether there is something stuck in the toolhead.
18FF810000020001.zh: 挤出切换动作异常，请检查是否有异物卡在工具头内。
